original: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶהָ׃
text: Thou didst pluck up a vine out of Egypt; Thou didst drive out the nations, and didst plant it.

original: פִּנִּיתָ לְפָנֶיהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵשׁ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָרֶץ׃
text: Thou didst clear a place before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.

original: כָּסּוּ הָרִים צִלָּהּ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ אַרְזֵי־אֵל׃
text: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the mighty cedars with the boughs thereof.

original: תְּשַׁלַּח קְצִירֶהָ עַד־יָם וְאֶל־נָהָר יוֹנְקוֹתֶיהָ׃
text: She sent out her branches unto the sea, And her shoots unto the River.

original: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ׃
text: Why hast Thou broken down her fences, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck her?

original: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶנָּה׃
text: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, That which moveth in the field feedeth on it.

original: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שׁוּב־נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹאת׃
text: O God of hosts, return, we beseech Thee; Look from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine,

original: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל־בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּךְ׃
text: And of the stock which Thy right hand hath planted, And the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself. .

original: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ׃
text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.

original: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ עַל־אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ׃
text: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.

original: וְלֹא־נָסוֹג מִמֶּךָּ תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא׃
text: So shall we not turn back from Thee; Quicken Thou us, and we will call upon Thy name.

original: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
text: O LORD God of hosts, restore us; Cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

original: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לְאָסָף׃
text: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.

original: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
text: Sing aloud unto God our strength; shout unto the God of Jacob.

original: שְׂאוּ־זִמְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹף כִּנּוֹר נָעִים עִם־נָבֶל׃
text: Take up the melody, and sound the timbrel, the sweet harp with the psaltery.

original: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ׃
text: Blow the horn at the new moon, at the full moon for our feast-day.

original: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
text: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

original: עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ בְּצֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם שְׂפַת לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע׃
text: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when He went forth against the land of Egypt. The speech of one that I knew not did I hear:

original: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹרְנָה׃
text: 'I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the basket.

original: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה׃
text: Thou didst call in trouble, and I rescued thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah

original: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־תִּשְׁמַע־לִי׃
text: Hear, O My people, and I will admonish thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto Me!

original: לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָר׃
text: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

original: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ׃
text: I am the LORD thy God, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt; open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

original: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־אָבָה לִי׃
text: But My people hearkened not to My voice; And Israel would none of Me.

original: וָאֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִירוּת לִבָּם יֵלְכוּ בְּמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם׃
text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

original: לוּ עַמִּי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְרָכַי יְהַלֵּכוּ׃
text: Oh that My people would hearken unto Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!

original: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִי׃
text: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.

original: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָם׃
text: The haters of the LORD should dwindle away before Him; And their punishment should endure for ever.

original: וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵלֶב חִטָּה וּמִצּוּר דְּבַשׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ׃
text: They should also be fed with the fat of wheat; and with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.'

original: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת־אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּט׃
text: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; in the midst of the judges He judgeth:

original: עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־עָוֶל וּפְנֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּשְׂאוּ־סֶלָה׃
text: 'How long will ye judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah

original: שִׁפְטוּ־דַל וְיָתוֹם עָנִי וָרָשׁ הַצְדִּיקוּ׃
text: Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

original: פַּלְּטוּ־דַל וְאֶבְיוֹן מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים הַצִּילוּ׃
text: Rescue the poor and needy; deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

original: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל־מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃
text: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.

original: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶם׃
text: I said: Ye are godlike beings, and all of you sons of the Most High.

original: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּלוּ׃
text: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.'

original: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּי־אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם׃
text: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for Thou shalt possess all the nations.

original: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף׃
text: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.

original: אֱלֹהִים אַל־דֳּמִי־לָךְ אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ וְאַל־תִּשְׁקֹט אֵל׃
text: O God, keep not Thou silence; Hold not Thy peace, and be not still, O God.

original: כִּי־הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ׃
text: For, lo, Thine enemies are in an uproar; And they that hate Thee have lifted up the head.

original: עַל־עַמְּךָ יַעֲרִימוּ סוֹד וְיִתְיָעֲצוּ עַל־צְפוּנֶיךָ׃
text: They hold crafty converse against Thy people, And take counsel against Thy treasured ones.

original: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹא־יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד׃
text: They have said: 'Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.'

original: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ׃
text: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against Thee do they make a covenant;

original: אָהֳלֵי אֱדוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִים מוֹאָב וְהַגְרִים׃
text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

original: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם־יֹשְׁבֵי צוֹר׃
text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

original: גַּם־אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי־לוֹט סֶלָה׃
text: Assyria also is joined with them; They have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah

original: עֲשֵׂה־לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּסִיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃
text: Do Thou unto them as unto Midian; As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook Kishon;

original: נִשְׁמְדוּ בְעֵין־דֹּאר הָיוּ דֹּמֶן לָאֲדָמָה׃
text: Who were destroyed at En-dor; They became as dung for the earth.

original: שִׁיתֵמוֹ נְדִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵב וְכִזְאֵב וּכְזֶבַח וּכְצַלְמֻנָּע כָּל־נְסִיכֵמוֹ׃
text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And like Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes;

original: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים׃
text: Who said: 'Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.'

original: אֱ‍לֹהַי שִׁיתֵמוֹ כַגַּלְגַּל כְּקַשׁ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ׃
text: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.

original: כְּאֵשׁ תִּבְעַר־יָעַר וּכְלֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט הָרִים׃
text: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains ablaze;

original: כֵּן תִּרְדְּפֵם בְּסַעֲרֶךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ תְבַהֲלֵם׃
text: So pursue them with Thy tempest, And affright them with Thy storm.

original: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה׃
text: Fill their faces with shame; That they may seek Thy name, O LORD.

original: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ עֲדֵי־עַד וְיַחְפְּרוּ וְיֹאבֵדוּ׃
text: Let them be ashamed and affrighted for ever; Yea, let them be abashed and perish;

original: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
text: That they may know that it is Thou alone whose name is the LORD, The Most High over all the earth.

original: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
text: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

original: מַה־יְּדִידוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת׃
text: How lovely are Thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

original: נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה נַפְשִׁי לְחַצְרוֹת יְהוָה לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ אֶל אֵל־חָי׃
text: My soul yearneth, yea, even pineth for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh sing for joy unto the living God.

original: גַּם־צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי׃
text: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young; Thine altars, O LORD of hosts, My King, and my God—

original: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
text: Happy are they that dwell in Thy house, they are ever praising Thee. Selah

original: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עוֹז־לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם׃
text: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are the highways.

original: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם־בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶה׃
text: Passing through the valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; yea, the early rain clotheth it with blessings.

original: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל־חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן׃
text: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

original: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
text: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

original: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
text: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of Thine anointed.

original: כִּי טוֹב־יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶשַׁע׃
text: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand; I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

original: כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים חֵן וְכָבוֹד יִתֵּן יְהוָה לֹא יִמְנַע־טוֹב לַהֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים׃
text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD giveth grace and glory; No good thing will He withhold from them that walk uprightly.

original: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ׃
text: O LORD of hosts, happy is the man that trusteth in Thee.

original: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
text: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

original: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שבות [שְׁבִית] יַעֲקֹב׃
text: LORD, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.

original: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶלָה׃
text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah .

original: אָסַפְתָּ כָל־עֶבְרָתֶךָ הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ׃
text: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.

original: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּעַסְךָ עִמָּנוּ׃
text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.

original: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
text: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?

original: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנוּ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂמְחוּ־בָךְ׃
text: Wilt Thou not quicken us again, That Thy people may rejoice in Thee?

original: הַרְאֵנוּ יְהוָה חַסְדֶּךָ וְיֶשְׁעֲךָ תִּתֶּן־לָנוּ׃
text: Show us Thy mercy, O LORD, And grant us Thy salvation.

original: אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה־יְדַבֵּר הָאֵל יְהוָה כִּי יְדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָיו וְאַל־יָשׁוּבוּ לְכִסְלָה׃
text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; For He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.

original: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵנוּ׃
text: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; That glory may dwell in our land.

original: חֶסֶד־וֶאֱמֶת נִפְגָּשׁוּ צֶדֶק וְשָׁלוֹם נָשָׁקוּ׃
text: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

original: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָף׃
text: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

original: גַּם־יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָהּ׃
text: Yea, the LORD will give that which is good; And our land shall yield her produce.

original: צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו׃
text: Righteousness shall go before Him, And shall make His footsteps a way.

original: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּה־יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי׃
text: A Prayer of David. Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.

original: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָסִיד אָנִי הוֹשַׁע עַבְדְּךָ אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי הַבּוֹטֵחַ אֵלֶיךָ׃
text: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O Thou my God, save Thy servant that trusteth in Thee.

original: חָנֵּנִי אֲדֹנָי כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
text: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; For unto Thee do I cry all the day.

original: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃
text: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant; For unto Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

original: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ׃
text: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to pardon, And plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Thee.

original: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָי׃
text: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; And attend unto the voice of my supplications.

original: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֶקְרָאֶךָּ כִּי תַעֲנֵנִי׃
text: In the day of my trouble I call upon Thee; For Thou wilt answer me.

original: אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ׃
text: There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O Lord, And there are no works like Thine.

original: כָּל־גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ׃
text: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify Thy name.

original: כִּי־גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃
text: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things; Thou art God alone.

original: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ׃
text: Teach me, O LORD, Thy way, that I may walk in Thy truth; Make one my heart to fear Thy name. .

original: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
text: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify Thy name for evermore.

original: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה׃
text: For great is Thy mercy toward me; And Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest nether-world.

original: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָמוּ־עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם׃
text: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And the company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set Thee before them.

original: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל־רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃
text: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

original: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָה־עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶךָ׃
text: O turn unto me, and be gracious unto me; Give Thy strength unto Thy servant, And save the son of Thy handmaid.

original: עֲשֵׂה־עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְיִרְאוּ שֹׂנְאַי וְיֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲזַרְתַּנִי וְנִחַמְתָּנִי׃
text: Work in my behalf a sign for good; That they that hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because Thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.

original: לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר יְסוּדָתוֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ׃
text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

original: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
text: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

original: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה׃
text: Glorious things are spoken of Thee, O city of God. Selah

original: אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיֹדְעָי הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם־כּוּשׁ זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם׃
text: 'I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know Me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this one was born there.'

original: וּלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
text: But of Zion it shall be said: 'This man and that was born in her; And the Most High Himself doth establish her.'

original: יְהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם סֶלָה׃
text: The LORD shall count in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah

original: וְשָׁרִים כְּחֹלְלִים כָּל־מַעְיָנַי בָּךְ׃
text: And whether they sing or dance, all my thoughts are in Thee.

original: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
text: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Leader; upon Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.

original: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם־צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
text: O LORD, God of my salvation, What time I cry in the night before Thee,

original: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִי הַטֵּה־אָזְנְךָ לְרִנָּתִי׃
text: Let my prayer come before Thee, Incline Thine ear unto my cry.

original: כִּי־שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּיעוּ׃
text: For my soul is sated with troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

original: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין־אֱיָל׃
text: I am counted with them that go down into the pit; I am become as a man that hath no help;

original: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ׃
text: Set apart among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom Thou rememberest no more; And they are cut off from Thy hand. .

original: שַׁתַּנִי בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים בִּמְצֹלוֹת׃
text: Thou hast laid me in the nether-most pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

original: עָלַי סָמְכָה חֲמָתֶךָ וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה׃
text: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And all Thy waves Thou pressest down. Selah

original: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵא׃
text: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them; I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

original: עֵינִי דָאֲבָה מִנִּי עֹנִי קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה בְּכָל־יוֹם שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַפָּי׃
text: Mine eye languisheth by reason of affliction; I have called upon Thee, O LORD, every day, I have spread forth my hands unto Thee.

original: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּלֶא אִם־רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
text: Wilt Thou work wonders for the dead? Or shall the shades arise and give Thee thanks? Selah

original: הַיְסֻפַּר בַּקֶּבֶר חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָּאֲבַדּוֹן׃
text: Shall Thy mercy be declared in the grave? Or Thy faithfulness in destruction?

original: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּה׃
text: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? And Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

original: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶךָּ׃
text: But as for me, unto Thee, O LORD, do I cry, And in the morning doth my prayer come to meet Thee.

original: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃
text: LORD, why castest Thou off my soul? Why hidest Thou Thy face from me?

original: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגֹוֵעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפוּנָה׃
text: I am afflicted and at the point of death from my youth up; I have borne Thy terrors, I am distracted.

original: עָלַי עָבְרוּ חֲרוֹנֶיךָ בִּעוּתֶיךָ צִמְּתוּתֻנִי׃
text: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

original: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָחַד׃
text: They came round about me like water all the day; They compassed me about together.

original: הִרְחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנִּי אֹהֵב וָרֵעַ מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ׃
text: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.

original: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
text: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

original: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי׃
text: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever; To all generations will I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth.

original: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶם׃
text: For I have said: 'For ever is mercy built; In the very heavens Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness.

original: כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּי׃
text: I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn unto David My servant:

original: עַד־עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר־וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶלָה׃
text: For ever will I establish thy seed, And build up thy throne to all generations.' Selah

original: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף־אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִׁים׃
text: So shall the heavens praise Thy wonders, O LORD, Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

original: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים׃
text: For who in the skies can be compared unto the LORD, Who among the sons of might can be likened unto the LORD,

original: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָיו׃
text: A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, And feared of all them that are about Him?

original: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי־כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ׃
text: O LORD God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto Thee, O LORD? And Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.

original: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם׃
text: Thou rulest the proud swelling of the sea; When the waves thereof arise, Thou stillest them.

original: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ׃
text: Thou didst crush Rahab, as one that is slain; Thou didst scattered Thine enemies with the arm of Thy strength.

original: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף־לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם׃
text: Thine are the heavens, Thine also the earth; The world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.

original: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
text: The north and the south, Thou hast created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Thy name.

original: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶךָ׃
text: Thine is an arm with might; Strong is Thy hand, and exalted is Thy right hand.

original: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ׃
text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne; Mercy and truth go before Thee.

original: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּאוֹר־פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
text: Happy is the people that know the joyful shout; They walk, O LORD, in the light of Thy countenance.

original: בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִילוּן כָּל־הַיּוֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ יָרוּמוּ׃
text: In Thy name do they rejoice all the day; And through Thy righteousness are they exalted.

original: כִּי־תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תרים [תָּרוּם] קַרְנֵנוּ׃
text: For Thou art the glory of their strength; And in Thy favour our horn is exalted.

original: כִּי לַיהוָה מָגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּנוּ׃
text: For of the LORD is our shield; And the Holy One of Israel is our king.

original: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּ־בְחָזוֹן לַחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל־גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָם׃
text: Then Thou spokest in vision to Thy godly ones, And saidst: 'I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

original: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּיו׃
text: I have found David My servant; With My holy oil have I anointed him;

original: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶנּוּ׃
text: With whom My hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

original: לֹא־יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן־עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּנּוּ׃
text: The enemy shall not exact from him; Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

original: וְכַתּוֹתִי מִפָּנָיו צָרָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו אֶגּוֹף׃
text: And I will beat to pieces his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

original: וֶאֶמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנוֹ׃
text: But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him; And through My name shall his horn be exalted.

original: וְשַׂמְתִּי בַיָּם יָדוֹ וּבַנְּהָרוֹת יְמִינוֹ׃
text: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

original: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
text: He shall call unto Me: Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation. .

original: אַף־אָנִי בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ עֶלְיוֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃
text: I also will appoint him first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.

original: לְעוֹלָם אשמור־[אֶשְׁמָר־] לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לוֹ׃
text: For ever will I keep for him My mercy, And My covenant shall stand fast with him.

original: וְשַׂמְתִּי לָעַד זַרְעוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ כִּימֵי שָׁמָיִם׃
text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

original: אִם־יַעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכוּן׃
text: If his children forsake My law, And walk not in Mine ordinances; :

original: אִם־חֻקֹּתַי יְחַלֵּלוּ וּמִצְוֺתַי לֹא יִשְׁמֹרוּ׃
text: If they profane My statutes, And keep not My commandments;

original: וּפָקַדְתִּי בְשֵׁבֶט פִּשְׁעָם וּבִנְגָעִים עֲוֺנָם׃
text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with strokes.

original: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־אָפִיר מֵעִמּוֹ וְלֹא־אֲשַׁקֵּר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִי׃
text: But My mercy will I not break off from him, Nor will I be false to My faithfulness.

original: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּה׃
text: My covenant will I not profane, Nor alter that which is gone out of My lips.

original: אַחַת נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁי אִם־לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּב׃
text: Once have I sworn by My holiness: Surely I will not be false unto David;

original: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּי׃
text: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before Me.

original: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶלָה׃
text: It shall be established for ever as the moon; And be stedfast as the witness in sky.' Selah

original: וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָס הִתְעַבַּרְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
text: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with Thine anointed.

original: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרוֹ׃
text: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of Thy servant; Thou hast profaned his crown even to the ground.

original: פָּרַצְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָיו שַׂמְתָּ מִבְצָרָיו מְחִתָּה׃
text: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

original: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָיו׃
text: All that pass by the way spoil him; He is become a taunt to his neighbours.

original: הֲרִימוֹתָ יְמִין צָרָיו הִשְׂמַחְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָיו׃
text: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

original: אַף־תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
text: Yea, Thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.

original: הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטְּהָרוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ לָאָרֶץ מִגַּרְתָּה׃
text: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

original: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶלָה׃
text: The days of his youth hast Thou shortened; Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah

original: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶךָ׃
text: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou hide Thyself for ever? How long shall Thy wrath burn like fire?

original: זְכָר־אֲנִי מֶה־חָלֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם׃
text: O remember how short my time is; For what vanity hast Thou created all the children of men!

original: מִי גֶבֶר יִחְיֶה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה־מָּוֶת יְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל סֶלָה׃
text: What man is he that liveth and shall not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of the grave? Selah

original: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
text: Where are Thy former mercies, O Lord, Which Thou didst swear unto David in Thy faithfulness?

original: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל־רַבִּים עַמִּים׃
text: Remember, Lord, the taunt of Thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the taunt of] so many peoples;

original: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
text: Wherewith Thine enemies have taunted, O LORD, Wherewith they have taunted the footsteps of Thine anointed.

original: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
text: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

original: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲ‍דֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר׃
text: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.

original: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל׃
text: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.

original: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם׃
text: Thou turnest man to contrition; And sayest: 'Return, ye children of men.'

original: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה׃
text: For a thousand years in Thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.

original: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף׃
text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep; In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

original: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ׃
text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

original: כִּי־כָלִינוּ בְאַפֶּךָ וּבַחֲמָתְךָ נִבְהָלְנוּ׃
text: For we are consumed in Thine anger, And by Thy wrath are we hurried away.

original: שת [שַׁתָּה] עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ׃
text: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, Our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.

original: כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה׃
text: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath; We bring our years to an end as a tale that is told.

original: יְמֵי־שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי־גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה׃
text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but travail and vanity; For it is speedily gone, and we fly away.

original: מִי־יוֹדֵעַ עֹז אַפֶּךָ וּכְיִרְאָתְךָ עֶבְרָתֶךָ׃
text: Who knoweth the power of Thine anger, And Thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto Thee?

original: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה׃
text: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

original: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
text: Return, O LORD; how long? And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.

original: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ׃
text: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy mercy; That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

original: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה׃
text: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, According to the years wherein we have seen evil.

original: יֵרָאֶה אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ פָעֳלֶךָ וַהֲדָרְךָ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶם׃
text: Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, And Thy glory upon their children.

original: וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ׃
text: And let the graciousness of the Lord our God be upon us; Establish Thou also upon us the work of our hands; Yea, the work of our hands establish Thou it.

original: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃
text: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, And abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;

original: אֹמַר לַיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ׃
text: I will say of the LORD, who is my refuge and my fortress, My God, in whom I trust,

original: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת׃
text: That He will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the noisome pestilence.

original: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ׃
text: He will cover thee with His pinions, And under His wings shalt thou take refuge; His truth is a shield and a buckler.

original: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם׃
text: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night, Nor of the arrow that flieth by day;

original: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם׃
text: Of the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor of the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

original: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ׃
text: A thousand may fall at Thy side, And ten thousand at Thy right hand; It shall not come nigh thee.

original: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the recompense of the wicked.

original: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ׃
text: For thou hast made the LORD who is my refuge, Even the Most High, thy habitation.

original: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ׃
text: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

original: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ׃
text: For He will give His angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.

original: עַל־כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶךָ׃
text: They shall bear thee upon their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

original: עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין׃
text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and asp; The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under feet.

original: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי׃
text: 'Because he hath set his love upon Me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known My name.

original: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ׃
text: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him, and bring him to honour.

original: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי׃
text: With long life will I satisfy him, And make Him to behold My salvation.'

original: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃
text: A Psalm, a Song. For the sabbath day.

original: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, And to sing praises unto Thy name, O Most High;

original: לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת׃
text: To declare Thy lovingkindness in the morning, And Thy faithfulness in the night seasons,

original: עֲ‍לֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר׃
text: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.

original: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
text: For Thou, LORD, hast made me glad through Thy work; I will exult in the works of Thy hands.

original: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ׃
text: How great are Thy works, O LORD! Thy thoughts are very deep.

original: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת׃
text: A brutish man knoweth not, Neither doth a fool understand this.

original: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד׃
text: When the wicked spring up as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they may be destroyed for ever.

original: וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְהוָה׃
text: But Thou, O LORD, art on high for evermore.

original: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
text: For, lo, Thine enemies, O LORD, For, lo, Thine enemies shall perish: All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

original: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן׃
text: But my horn hast Thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox; I am anointed with rich oil.

original: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָי׃
text: Mine eye also hath gazed on them that lie in wait for me, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

original: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה׃
text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree; He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

original: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ׃
text: Planted in the house of the LORD, They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

original: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ׃
text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and richness;

original: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהוָה צוּרִי וְלֹא־עלתה [עַוְלָתָה] בּוֹ׃
text: To declare that the LORD is upright, My Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.

original: יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט׃
text: The LORD reigneth; He is clothed in majesty; The LORD is clothed, He hath girded Himself with strength; Yea, the world is established, that it cannot be moved.

original: נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָתָּה׃
text: Thy throne is established of old; Thou art from everlasting.

original: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם׃
text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their roaring.

original: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהוָה׃
text: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, The LORD on high is mighty.

original: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃
text: Thy testimonies are very sure, Holiness becometh Thy house, O LORD, for evermore.

original: אֵל־נְקָמוֹת יְהוָה אֵל נְקָמוֹת הוֹפִיַע׃
text: O LORD, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

original: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים׃
text: Lift up Thyself, Thou Judge of the earth; Render to the proud their recompense.

original: עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹזוּ׃
text: LORD, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked exult?

original: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
text: They gush out, they speak arrogancy; All the workers of iniquity bear themselves loftily.

original: עַמְּךָ יְהוָה יְדַכְּאוּ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ יְעַנּוּ׃
text: They crush Thy people, O LORD, And afflict Thy heritage.

original: אַלְמָנָה וְגֵר יַהֲרֹגוּ וִיתוֹמִים יְרַצֵּחוּ׃
text: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.

original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא יִרְאֶה־יָּהּ וְלֹא־יָבִין אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
text: And they say: 'The LORD will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob give heed.'

original: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּילוּ׃
text: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye understand?

original: הֲנֹטַע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִם־יֹצֵר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּיט׃
text: He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?

original: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּעַת׃
text: He that instructeth nations, shall not He correct? Even He that teacheth man knowledge?

original: יְהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי־הֵמָּה הָבֶל׃
text: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.

original: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ׃
text: Happy is the man whom Thou instructest, O LORD, And teachest out of Thy law;

original: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָׁחַת׃
text: That Thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

original: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹב׃
text: For the LORD will not cast off His people, Neither will He forsake His inheritance.

original: כִּי־עַד־צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
text: For right shall return unto justice, And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

original: מִי־יָקוּם לִי עִם־מְרֵעִים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
text: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

original: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִׁי׃
text: Unless the LORD had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

original: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵנִי׃
text: If I say: 'My foot slippeth', Thy mercy, O LORD, holdeth me up.

original: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
text: When my cares are many within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.

original: הַיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי־חֹק׃
text: Shall the seat of wickedness have fellowship with Thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

original: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִׁיעוּ׃
text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.

original: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִי׃
text: But the LORD hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

original: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
text: And He hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own evil; The LORD our God will cut them off.

original: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵנוּ׃
text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD; Let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

original: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַ לוֹ׃
text: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, Let us shout for joy unto Him with psalms.

original: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
text: For the LORD is a great God, And a great King above all gods;

original: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָרֶץ וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ׃
text: In whose hand are the depths of the earth; The heights of the mountains are His also.

original: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָרוּ׃
text: The sea is His, and He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.

original: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה עֹשֵׂנוּ׃
text: O come, let us bow down and bend the knee; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

original: כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם אִם־בְּקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ׃
text: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, and the flock of His hand. To-day, if ye would but hearken to His voice!

original: אַל־תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
text: 'Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

original: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם־רָאוּ פָעֳלִי׃
text: When your fathers tried Me, Proved Me, even though they saw My work.

original: אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָקוּט בְּדוֹר וָאֹמַר עַם תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם וְהֵם לֹא־יָדְעוּ דְרָכָי׃
text: For forty years was I wearied with that generation, And said: It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known My ways;

original: אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְאַפִּי אִם־יְבֹאוּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִי׃
text: Wherefore I swore in My wrath, That they should not enter into My rest.'

original: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
text: O sing unto the LORD a new song; Sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

original: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם־לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ׃
text: Sing unto the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim His salvation from day to day.

original: סַפְּרוּ בַגּוֹיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּים נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
text: Declare His glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

original: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד נוֹרָא הוּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
text: For great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods. .

original: כִּי כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָׂה׃
text: For all the gods of the peoples are things of nought; But the LORD made the heavens.

original: הוֹד־וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְתִפְאֶרֶת בְּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ׃
text: Honour and majesty are before Him; Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.

original: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃
text: Ascribe unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto the LORD glory and strength.

original: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאוּ־מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָיו׃
text: Ascribe unto the LORD the glory due unto His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.

original: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
text: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; Tremble before Him, all the earth.

original: אִמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָךְ אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יָדִין עַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
text: Say among the nations: 'The LORD reigneth.' The world also is established that it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

original: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ׃
text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

original: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר׃
text: Let the field exult; and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy;

original: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
text: Before the LORD, for He is come; For He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples in His faithfulness.

original: יְהוָה מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׂמְחוּ אִיִּים רַבִּים׃
text: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

original: עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל סְבִיבָיו צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ׃
text: Clouds and darkness are round about Him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.

original: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֵּלֵךְ וּתְלַהֵט סָבִיב צָרָיו׃
text: A fire goeth before Him, And burneth up His adversaries round about.

original: הֵאִירוּ בְרָקָיו תֵּבֵל רָאֲתָה וַתָּחֵל הָאָרֶץ׃
text: His lightnings lighted up the world; The earth saw, and trembled.

original: הָרִים כַּדּוֹנַג נָמַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה מִלִּפְנֵי אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
text: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

original: הִגִּידוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ וְרָאוּ כָל־הָעַמִּים כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
text: The heavens declared His righteousness, And all the peoples saw His glory.

original: יֵבֹשׁוּ כָּל־עֹבְדֵי פֶסֶל הַמִּתְהַלְלִים בָּאֱלִילִים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
text: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, That boast themselves of things of nought; Bow down to Him, all ye gods.

original: שָׁמְעָה וַתִּשְׂמַח צִיּוֹן וַתָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָה׃
text: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced; Because of Thy judgments, O LORD.

original: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלֵיתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
text: For Thou, LORD, art most high above all the earth; Thou art exalted far above all gods.

original: אֹהֲבֵי יְהוָה שִׂנְאוּ רָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידָיו מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים יַצִּילֵם׃
text: O ye that love the LORD, hate evil; He preserveth the souls of His saints; He delivered them out of the hand of the wicked.

original: אוֹר זָרֻעַ לַצַּדִּיק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב שִׂמְחָה׃
text: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

original: שִׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃
text: Be glad in the LORD, ye righteous; And give thanks to His holy name.

original: מִזְמוֹר שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ כִּי־נִפְלָאוֹת עָשָׂה הוֹשִׁיעָה־לּוֹ יְמִינוֹ וּזְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ׃
text: A Psalm. O sing unto the LORD a new song; For He hath done marvellous things; His right hand, and His holy arm, hath wrought salvation for Him.

original: הוֹדִיעַ יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָתוֹ לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם גִּלָּה צִדְקָתוֹ׃
text: The LORD hath made known His salvation; His righteousness hath He revealed in the sight of the nations.

original: זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ אֵת יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
text: He hath remembered His mercy and His faithfulness toward the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

original: הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ פִּצְחוּ וְרַנְּנוּ וְזַמֵּרוּ׃
text: Shout unto the LORD, all the earth; Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

original: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּכִנּוֹר וְקוֹל זִמְרָה׃
text: Sing praises unto the LORD with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

original: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה׃
text: With trumpets and sound of the horn Shout ye before the King, the LORD.

original: יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;

original: נְהָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־כָף יַחַד הָרִים יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
text: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the mountains sing for joy together;

original: לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
text: Before the LORD, for He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.

original: יְהוָה מָלָךְ יִרְגְּזוּ עַמִּים יֹשֵׁב כְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָרֶץ׃
text: The LORD reigneth; let the peoples tremble; He is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.

original: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל־כָּל־הָעַמִּים׃
text: The LORD is great in Zion; And He is high above all the peoples.

original: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃
text: Let them praise Thy name as great and awful; Holy is He.

original: וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ מִשְׁפָּט אָהֵב אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃
text: The strength also of the king who loveth justice— Thou hast established equity, Thou hast executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.

original: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃
text: Exalt ye the LORD our God, And prostrate yourselves at His footstool; Holy is He.

original: מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן בְּכֹהֲנָיו וּשְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵי שְׁמוֹ קֹרִאים אֶל־יְהוָה וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם׃
text: Moses and Aaron among His priests, And Samuel among them that call upon His name, Did call upon the LORD, and He answered them.

original: בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן־לָמוֹ׃
text: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud; They kept His testimonies, and the statute that He gave them.

original: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַתָּה עֲנִיתָם אֵל נֹשֵׂא הָיִיתָ לָהֶם וְנֹקֵם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָם׃
text: O LORD our God, Thou didst answer them; A forgiving God wast Thou unto them, Though Thou tookest vengeance of their misdeeds.

original: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
text: Exalt ye the LORD our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the LORD our God is holy.

original: מִזְמוֹר לְתוֹדָה הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout unto the LORD, all the earth.

original: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה׃
text: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.

original: דְּעוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוּא אֱלֹהִים הוּא־עָשָׂנוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֲנַחְנוּ עַמּוֹ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתוֹ׃
text: Know ye that the LORD He is God; it is He that hath made us, and we are His, His people, and the flock of His pasture.

original: בֹּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה הוֹדוּ־לוֹ בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ׃
text: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, and into His courts with praise; give thanks unto Him, and bless His name.

original: כִּי־טוֹב יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד־דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
text: For the LORD is good; His mercy endureth for ever; and His faithfulness unto all generations.

original: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר חֶסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה לְךָ יְהוָה אֲזַמֵּרָה׃
text: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and justice; unto Thee, O LORD, will I sing praises.

original: אַשְׂכִּילָה בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלָי אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם־לְבָבִי בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי׃
text: I will give heed unto the way of integrity; oh when wilt Thou come unto me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.

original: לֹא־אָשִׁית לְנֶגֶד עֵינַי דְּבַר־בְּלִיָּעַל עֲשֹׂה־סֵטִים שָׂנֵאתִי לֹא יִדְבַּק בִּי׃
text: I will set no base thing before mine eyes; I hate the doing of things crooked; it shall not cleave unto me.

original: לֵבָב עִקֵּשׁ יָסוּר מִמֶּנִּי רָע לֹא אֵדָע׃
text: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know no evil thing.

original: מלושני [מְלָשְׁנִי] בַסֵּתֶר רֵעֵהוּ אוֹתוֹ אַצְמִית גְּבַהּ־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב אֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃
text: Whoso slandereth his neighbour in secret, him will I destroy; Whoso is haughty of eye and proud of heart, him will I not suffer.

original: עֵינַי בְּנֶאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵנִי׃
text: Mine eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a way of integrity, he shall minister unto me.

original: לֹא־יֵשֵׁב בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה דֹּבֵר שְׁקָרִים לֹא־יִכּוֹן לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי׃
text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.

original: לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לְהַכְרִית מֵעִיר־יְהוָה כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
text: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the LORD.

original: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִי־יַעֲטֹף וְלִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחוֹ׃
text: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he fainteth, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.

original: יְהוָה שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא׃
text: O LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto Thee.

original: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי בְּיוֹם צַר לִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנֶךָ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
text: Hide not Thy face from me in the day of my distress; incline Thine ear unto me; in the day when I call answer me speedily.

original: כִּי־כָלוּ בְעָשָׁן יָמָי וְעַצְמוֹתַי כְּמוֹ־קֵד נִחָרוּ׃
text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a hearth.

original: הוּכָּה־כָעֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַשׁ לִבִּי כִּי־שָׁכַחְתִּי מֵאֲכֹל לַחְמִי׃
text: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; for I forget to eat my bread.

original: מִקּוֹל אַנְחָתִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי לִבְשָׂרִי׃
text: By reason of the voice of my sighing My bones cleave to my flesh.

original: דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי כְּכוֹס חֳרָבוֹת׃
text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

original: שָׁקַדְתִּי וָאֶהְיֶה כְּצִפּוֹר בּוֹדֵד עַל־גָּג׃
text: I watch, and am become like a sparrow that is alone upon the housetop.

original: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חֵרְפוּנִי אוֹיְבָי מְהוֹלָלַי בִּי נִשְׁבָּעוּ׃
text: Mine enemies taunt me all the day; they that are mad against me do curse by me.

original: כִּי־אֵפֶר כַּלֶּחֶם אָכָלְתִּי וְשִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָכְתִּי׃
text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

original: מִפְּנֵי־זַעַמְךָ וְקִצְפֶּךָ כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי׃
text: Because of Thine indignation and Thy wrath; for Thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

original: יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי וַאֲנִי כָּעֵשֶׂב אִיבָשׁ׃
text: My days are like a lengthening shadow; and I am withered like grass.

original: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב וְזִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
text: But Thou, O LORD, sittest enthroned for ever; and Thy name is unto all generations.

original: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי־עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ כִּי־בָא מוֹעֵד׃
text: Thou wilt arise, and have compassion upon Zion; for it is time to be gracious unto her, for the appointed time is come.

original: כִּי־רָצוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶיהָ וְאֶת־עֲפָרָהּ יְחֹנֵנוּ׃
text: For Thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust.

original: וְיִירְאוּ גוֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
text: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory;

original: כִּי־בָנָה יְהוָה צִיּוֹן נִרְאָה בִּכְבוֹדוֹ׃
text: When the LORD hath built up Zion, when He hath appeared in His glory;

original: פָּנָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּת הָעַרְעָר וְלֹא־בָזָה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם׃
text: When He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

original: תִּכָּתֶב זֹאת לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן וְעַם נִבְרָא יְהַלֶּל־יָהּ׃
text: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

original: כִּי־הִשְׁקִיף מִמְּרוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הִבִּיט׃
text: For He hath looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

original: לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר לְפַתֵּחַ בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;

original: לְסַפֵּר בְּצִיּוֹן שֵׁם יְהוָה וּתְהִלָּתוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
text: That men may tell of the name of the LORD in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem; .

original: בְּהִקָּבֵץ עַמִּים יַחְדָּו וּמַמְלָכוֹת לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה׃
text: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

original: עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ כחו [כֹּחִי] קִצַּר יָמָי׃
text: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

original: אֹמַר אֵלִי אַל־תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי בְּדוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ׃
text: I say: 'O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days, Thou whose years endure throughout all generations.

original: לְפָנִים הָאָרֶץ יָסַדְתָּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ שָׁמָיִם׃
text: Of old Thou didst lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of Thy hands.

original: הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וְכֻלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם וְיַחֲלֹפוּ׃
text: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt Thou change them, and they shall pass away;

original: וְאַתָּה־הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ׃
text: But Thou art the selfsame, And Thy years shall have no end.

original: בְּנֵי־עֲבָדֶיךָ יִשְׁכּוֹנוּ וְזַרְעָם לְפָנֶיךָ יִכּוֹן׃
text: The children of Thy servants shall dwell securely, And their seed shall be established before Thee.'

original: לְדָוִד בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְכָל־קְרָבַי אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ׃
text: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name.

original: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְאַל־תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל־גְּמוּלָיו׃
text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits;

original: הַסֹּלֵחַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵכִי הָרֹפֵא לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָיְכִי׃
text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquity; Who healeth all Thy diseases;

original: הַגּוֹאֵל מִשַּׁחַת חַיָּיְכִי הַמְעַטְּרֵכִי חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים׃
text: Who redeemeth Thy life from the pit; Who encompasseth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

original: הַמַּשְׂבִּיַע בַּטּוֹב עֶדְיֵךְ תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָיְכִי׃
text: Who satisfieth thine old age with good things; So that Thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

original: עֹשֵׂה צְדָקוֹת יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לְכָל־עֲשׁוּקִים׃
text: The LORD executeth righteousness, And acts of justice for all that are oppressed.

original: יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
text: He made known His ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

original: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חָסֶד׃
text: The LORD is full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

original: לֹא־לָנֶצַח יָרִיב וְלֹא לְעוֹלָם יִטּוֹר׃
text: He will not always contend; Neither will He keep His anger for ever.

original: לֹא כַחֲטָאֵינוּ עָשָׂה לָנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ גָּמַל עָלֵינוּ׃
text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor requited us according to our iniquities.

original: כִּי כִגְבֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ גָּבַר חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
text: For as the heaven is high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.

original: כִּרְחֹק מִזְרָח מִמַּעֲרָב הִרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ׃
text: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath He removed our transgressions from us.

original: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים רִחַם יְהוָה עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
text: Like as a father hath compassion upon his children, So hath the LORD compassion upon them that fear Him. .

original: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ׃
text: For He knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

original: אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּן יָצִיץ׃
text: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

original: כִּי רוּחַ עָבְרָה־בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקוֹמוֹ׃
text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof knoweth it no more.

original: וְחֶסֶד יְהוָה מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָיו וְצִדְקָתוֹ לִבְנֵי בָנִים׃
text: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, And His righteousness unto children's children;

original: לְשֹׁמְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵי פִקֻּדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹתָם׃
text: To such as keep His covenant, And to those that remember His precepts to do them.

original: יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֵכִין כִּסְאוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה׃
text: The LORD hath established His throne in the heavens; And His kingdom ruleth over all.

original: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה מַלְאָכָיו גִּבֹּרֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל דְּבָרוֹ׃
text: Bless the LORD, ye angels of His, Ye mighty in strength, that fulfil His word, Hearkening unto the voice of His word.

original: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־צְבָאָיו מְשָׁרְתָיו עֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנוֹ׃
text: Bless the LORD, all ye His hosts; Ye ministers of His, that do His pleasure.

original: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו בְּכָל־מְקֹמוֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃
text: Bless the LORD, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion; Bless the LORD, O my soul.

original: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי גָּדַלְתָּ מְּאֹד הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָשְׁתָּ׃
text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, Thou art very great; Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.

original: עֹטֶה־אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם כַּיְרִיעָה׃
text: Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment, who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

original: הַמְקָרֶה בַמַּיִם עֲ‍לִיּוֹתָיו הַשָּׂם־עָבִים רְכוּבוֹ הַמְהַלֵּךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃
text: Who layest the beams of Thine upper chambers in the waters, who makest the clouds Thy chariot, who walkest upon the wings of the wind;

original: עֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת מְשָׁרְתָיו אֵשׁ לֹהֵט׃
text: Who makest winds Thy messengers, the flaming fire Thy ministers.

original: יָסַד־אֶרֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶיהָ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
text: Who didst establish the earth upon its foundations, that it should not be moved for ever and ever;

original: תְּהוֹם כַּלְּבוּשׁ כִּסִּיתוֹ עַל־הָרִים יַעַמְדוּ־מָיִם׃
text: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains.

original: מִן־גַּעֲרָתְךָ יְנוּסוּן מִן־קוֹל רַעַמְךָ יֵחָפֵזוּן׃
text: At Thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of Thy thunder they hasted away—

original: יַעֲלוּ הָרִים יֵרְדוּ בְקָעוֹת אֶל־מְקוֹם זֶה יָסַדְתָּ לָהֶם׃
text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down— Unto the place which Thou hadst founded for them;

original: גְּבוּל־שַׂמְתָּ בַּל־יַעֲבֹרוּן בַּל־יְשׁוּבוּן לְכַסּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
text: Thou didst set a bound which they should not pass over, That they might not return to cover the earth.

original: הַמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
text: Who sendest forth springs into the valleys; They run between the mountains;

original: יַשְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי יִשְׁבְּרוּ פְרָאִים צְמָאָם׃
text: They give drink to every beast of the field, The wild asses quench their thirst. .

original: עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ־קוֹל׃
text: Beside them dwell the fowl of the heaven, From among the branches they sing.

original: מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו מִפְּרִי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ תִּשְׂבַּע הָאָרֶץ׃
text: Who waterest the mountains from Thine upper chambers; The earth is full of the fruit of Thy works.

original: מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר לַבְּהֵמָה וְעֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַת הָאָדָם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
text: Who causeth the grass to spring up for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; To bring forth bread out of the earth,

original: וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים מִשָּׁמֶן וְלֶחֶם לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד׃
text: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, Making the face brighter than oil, And bread that stayeth man's heart.

original: יִשְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵי יְהוָה אַרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָטָע׃
text: The trees of the LORD have their fill, The cedars of Lebanon, which He hath planted;

original: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ חֲסִידָה בְּרוֹשִׁים בֵּיתָהּ׃
text: Wherein the birds make their nests; As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.

original: הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַשְׁפַנִּים׃
text: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.

original: עָשָׂה יָרֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִים שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ׃
text: Who appointedst the moon for seasons; The sun knoweth his going down.

original: תָּשֶׁת־חֹשֶׁךְ וִיהִי לָיְלָה בּוֹ־תִרְמֹשׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר׃
text: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

original: הַכְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִים לַטָּרֶף וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵאֵל אָכְלָם׃
text: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

original: תִּזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפוּן וְאֶל־מְעוֹנֹתָם יִרְבָּצוּן׃
text: The sun ariseth, they slink away, And couch in their dens.

original: יֵצֵא אָדָם לְפָעֳלוֹ וְלַעֲבֹדָתוֹ עֲדֵי־עָרֶב׃
text: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labour until the evening.

original: מָה־רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ׃
text: How manifold are Thy works, O LORD! In wisdom hast Thou made them all; The earth is full of Thy creatures.

original: זֶה הַיָּם גָּדוֹל וּרְחַב יָדָיִם שָׁם־רֶמֶשׂ וְאֵין מִסְפָּר חַיּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת עִם־גְּדֹלוֹת׃
text: Yonder sea, great and wide, Therein are creeping things innumerable, Living creatures, both small and great.

original: שָׁם אֳנִיּוֹת יְהַלֵּכוּן לִוְיָתָן זֶה־יָצַרְתָּ לְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ׃
text: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom Thou hast formed to sport therein.

original: כֻּלָּם אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּן לָתֵת אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
text: All of them wait for Thee, That Thou mayest give them their food in due season.

original: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם יִלְקֹטוּן תִּפְתַּח יָדְךָ יִשְׂבְּעוּן טוֹב׃
text: Thou givest it unto them, they gather it; Thou openest Thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

original: תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ יִבָּהֵלוּן תֹּסֵף רוּחָם יִגְוָעוּן וְאֶל־עֲפָרָם יְשׁוּבוּן׃
text: Thou hidest Thy face, they vanish; Thou withdrawest their breath, they perish, And return to their dust.

original: תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵאוּן וּתְחַדֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אֲדָמָה׃
text: Thou sendest forth Thy spirit, they are created; and Thou renewest the face of the earth.

original: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו׃
text: May the glory of the LORD endure for ever; let the LORD rejoice in His works!

original: הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
text: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

original: אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

original: יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָה׃
text: Let my musing be sweet unto Him; as for me, I will rejoice in the LORD.

original: יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּרְשָׁעִים עוֹד אֵינָם בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: Let sinners cease out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah.

original: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
text: O give thanks unto the LORD, call upon His name; Make known His doings among the peoples.

original: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ שִׂיחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
text: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; Speak ye of all His marvellous works.

original: הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה׃
text: Glory ye in His holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

original: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִיד׃
text: Seek ye the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.

original: זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹפְתָיו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיו׃
text: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;

original: זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָיו׃
text: O ye seed of Abraham His servant, Ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.

original: הוּא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָיו׃
text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

original: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃
text: He hath remembered His covenant for ever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations;

original: אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ לְיִשְׂחָק׃
text: [The covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath unto Isaac;

original: וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃
text: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant;

original: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת־אֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶם׃
text: Saying: 'Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance.'

original: בִּהְיוֹתָם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּהּ׃
text: When they were but a few men in number. Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,

original: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל־גּוֹי מִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל־עַם אַחֵר׃
text: And when they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people,

original: לֹא־הִנִּיחַ אָדָם לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִים׃
text: He suffered no man to do them wrong, Yea, for their sake He reproved kings:

original: אַל־תִּגְּעוּ בִמְשִׁיחָי וְלִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵעוּ׃
text: 'Touch not Mine anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.'

original: וַיִּקְרָא רָעָב עַל־הָאָרֶץ כָּל־מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם שָׁבָר׃
text: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

original: שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף׃
text: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant;

original: עִנּוּ בַכֶּבֶל רגליו [רַגְלוֹ] בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
text: His feet they hurt with fetters, His person was laid in iron;

original: עַד־עֵת בֹּא־דְבָרוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרָפָתְהוּ׃
text: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD tested him.

original: שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ מֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ׃
text: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of the peoples, and set him free.

original: שָׂמוֹ אָדוֹן לְבֵיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנוֹ׃
text: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions;

original: לֶאְסֹר שָׂרָיו בְּנַפְשׁוֹ וּזְקֵנָיו יְחַכֵּם׃
text: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

original: וַיָּבֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצְרָיִם וְיַעֲקֹב גָּר בְּאֶרֶץ־חָם׃
text: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

original: וַיֶּפֶר אֶת־עַמּוֹ מְאֹד וַיַּעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָיו׃
text: And He increased His people greatly, And made them too mighty for their adversaries.

original: הָפַךְ לִבָּם לִשְׂנֹא עַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָיו׃
text: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.

original: שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ אַהֲרֹן אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ׃
text: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.

original: שָׂמוּ־בָם דִּבְרֵי אֹתוֹתָיו וּמֹפְתִים בְּאֶרֶץ חָם׃
text: They wrought among them His manifold signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

original: שָׁלַח חֹשֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁךְ וְלֹא־מָרוּ אֶת־דברוו [דְּבָרוֹ׃]
text: He sent darkness, and it was dark; And they rebelled not against His word.

original: הָפַךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶם לְדָם וַיָּמֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָם׃
text: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.

original: שָׁרַץ אַרְצָם צְפַרְדְּעִים בְּחַדְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם׃
text: Their land swarmed with frogs, In the chambers of their kings.

original: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כִּנִּים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָם׃
text: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And gnats in all their borders.

original: נָתַן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶם בָּרָד אֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת בְּאַרְצָם׃
text: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.

original: וַיַּךְ גַּפְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָם וַיְשַׁבֵּר עֵץ גְּבוּלָם׃
text: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; And broke the trees of their borders.

original: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא אַרְבֶּה וְיֶלֶק וְאֵין מִסְפָּר׃
text: He spoke, and the locust came, And the canker-worm without number,

original: וַיֹּאכַל כָּל־עֵשֶׂב בְּאַרְצָם וַיֹּאכַל פְּרִי אַדְמָתָם׃
text: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.

original: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּאַרְצָם רֵאשִׁית לְכָל־אוֹנָם׃
text: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The first-fruits of all their strength.

original: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין בִּשְׁבָטָיו כּוֹשֵׁל׃
text: And He brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was none that stumbled among His tribes.

original: שָׂמַח מִצְרַיִם בְּצֵאתָם כִּי־נָפַל פַּחְדָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃
text: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

original: פָּרַשׂ עָנָן לְמָסָךְ וְאֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָיְלָה׃
text: He spread a cloud for a screen; And fire to give light in the night.

original: שָׁאַל וַיָּבֵא שְׂלָו וְלֶחֶם שָׁמַיִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵם׃
text: They asked, and He brought quails, And gave them in plenty the bread of heaven.

original: פָּתַח צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מָיִם הָלְכוּ בַּצִּיּוֹת נָהָר׃
text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran, a river in the dry places.

original: כִּי־זָכַר אֶת־דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ׃
text: For He remembered His holy word Unto Abraham His servant;

original: וַיּוֹצִא עַמּוֹ בְשָׂשׂוֹן בְּרִנָּה אֶת־בְּחִירָיו׃
text: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with singing.

original: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים יִירָשׁוּ׃
text: And He gave them the lands of the nations, And they took the labour of the peoples in possession;

original: בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: That they might keep His statutes, And observe His laws. Hallelujah.

original: הַלְלוּיָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: Hallelujah. O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever.

original: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
text: Who can express the mighty acts of the LORD, or make all His praise to be heard?

original: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכָל־עֵת׃
text: Happy are they that keep justice, that do righteousness at all times.

original: זָכְרֵנִי יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
text: Remember me, O LORD, when Thou favourest Thy people; O think of me at Thy salvation;

original: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶךָ׃
text: That I may behold the prosperity of Thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thine inheritance.

original: חָטָאנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ הֶעֱוִינוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ׃
text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly.

original: אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־הִשְׂכִּילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת־רֹב חֲסָדֶיךָ וַיַּמְרוּ עַל־יָם בְּיַם־סוּף׃
text: Our fathers in Egypt gave no heed unto Thy wonders; they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies; but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

original: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתוֹ׃
text: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, that He might make His mighty power to be known.

original: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם־סוּף וַיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר׃
text: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

original: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵב׃
text: And He saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

original: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר׃
text: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

original: וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בִדְבָרָיו יָשִׁירוּ תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
text: Then believed they His words; They sang His praise.

original: מִהֲרוּ שָׁכְחוּ מַעֲשָׂיו לֹא־חִכּוּ לַעֲצָתוֹ׃
text: They soon forgot His works; They waited not for His counsel;

original: וַיִּתְאַוּוּ תַאֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּישִׁימוֹן׃
text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tried God in the desert.

original: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָׁם׃
text: And He gave them their request; But sent leanness into their soul.

original: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהוָה׃
text: They were jealous also of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron the holy one of the LORD.

original: תִּפְתַּח־אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל־עֲדַת אֲבִירָם׃
text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

original: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵשׁ בַּעֲדָתָם לֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט רְשָׁעִים׃
text: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

original: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵגֶל בְּחֹרֵב וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַסֵּכָה׃
text: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.

original: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב׃
