text: Thus they exchanged their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.

original: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָיִם׃
text: They forgot God their saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt;

original: נִפְלָאוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ חָם נוֹרָאוֹת עַל־יַם־סוּף׃
text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Terrible things by the Red Sea.

original: וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵהַשְׁחִית׃
text: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach, To turn back His wrath, lest He should destroy them.

original: וַיִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה לֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ לִדְבָרוֹ׃
text: Moreover, they scorned the desirable land, They believed not His word;

original: וַיֵּרָגְנוּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה׃
text: And they murmured in their tents, They hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

original: וַיִּשָּׂא יָדוֹ לָהֶם לְהַפִּיל אוֹתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
text: Therefore He swore concerning them, That He would overthrow them in the wilderness;

original: וּלְהַפִּיל זַרְעָם בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְזָרוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃
text: And that He would cast out their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.

original: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִים׃
text: They joined themselves also unto Baal of Peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.

original: וַיַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם וַתִּפְרָץ־בָּם מַגֵּפָה׃
text: Thus they provoked Him with their doings, And the plague broke in upon them.

original: וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּל וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה׃
text: Then stood up Phinehas, and wrought judgment, And so the plague was stayed.

original: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד־עוֹלָם׃
text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for ever.

original: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם׃
text: They angered Him also at the waters of Meribah, And it went ill with Moses because of them;

original: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אֶת־רוּחוֹ וַיְבַטֵּא בִּשְׂפָתָיו׃
text: For they embittered his spirit, And he spoke rashly with his lips.

original: לֹא־הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם׃
text: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD commanded them;

original: וַיִּתְעָרְבוּ בַגּוֹיִם וַיִּלְמְדוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם׃
text: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works;

original: וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ לָהֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
text: And they served their idols, Which became a snare unto them;

original: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לַשֵּׁדִים׃
text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

original: וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם נָקִי דַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר זִבְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּי כְנָעַן וַתֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ בַּדָּמִים׃
text: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

original: וַיִּטְמְאוּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃
text: Thus were they defiled with their works, And went astray in their doings.

original: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ וַיְתָעֵב אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ׃
text: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against His people, And He abhorred His inheritance.

original: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִם וַיִּמְשְׁלוּ בָהֶם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶם׃
text: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.

original: וַיִּלְחָצוּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּכָּנְעוּ תַּחַת יָדָם׃
text: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their hand.

original: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם׃
text: Many times did He deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And sank low through their iniquity.

original: וַיַּרְא בַּצַּר לָהֶם בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָם׃
text: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress, When He heard their cry;

original: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חסדו [חֲסָדָיו׃]
text: And He remembered for them His covenant, And repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

original: וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶם׃
text: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.

original: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶךָ׃
text: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the nations, That we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, That we may triumph in Thy praise.

original: בָּרוּךְ־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם וְאָמַר כָּל־הָעָם אָמֵן הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting, and let all the people say: 'Amen.' Hallelujah.

original: הֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.'

original: יֹאמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָם מִיַּד־צָר׃
text: So let the redeemed of the LORD say, Whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary;

original: וּמֵאֲרָצוֹת קִבְּצָם מִמִּזְרָח וּמִמַּעֲרָב מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּם׃
text: And gathered them out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the sea.

original: תָּעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימוֹן דָּרֶךְ עִיר מוֹשָׁב לֹא מָצָאוּ׃
text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

original: רְעֵבִים גַּם־צְמֵאִים נַפְשָׁם בָּהֶם תִּתְעַטָּף׃
text: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

original: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יַצִּילֵם׃
text: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.

original: וַיַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָלֶכֶת אֶל־עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
text: And He led them by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

original: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
text: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

original: כִּי־הִשְׂבִּיעַ נֶפֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה מִלֵּא־טוֹב׃
text: For He hath satisfied the longing soul, And the hungry soul He hath filled with good.

original: יֹשְׁבֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת אֲסִירֵי עֳנִי וּבַרְזֶל׃
text: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron—

original: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אִמְרֵי־אֵל וַעֲצַת עֶלְיוֹן נָאָצוּ׃
text: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High.

original: וַיַּכְנַע בֶּעָמָל לִבָּם כָּשְׁלוּ וְאֵין עֹזֵר׃
text: Therefore He humbled their heart with travail, They stumbled, and there was none to help—

original: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
text: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.

original: יוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת וּמוֹסְרוֹתֵיהֶם יְנַתֵּק׃
text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their bands in sunder. .

original: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
text: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

original: כִּי־שִׁבַּר דַּלְתוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵי בַרְזֶל גִּדֵּעַ׃
text: For He hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

original: אֱוִלִים מִדֶּרֶךְ פִּשְׁעָם וּמֵעֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶם יִתְעַנּוּ׃
text: Crazed because of the way of their transgression, And afflicted because of their iniquities—

original: כָּל־אֹכֶל תְּתַעֵב נַפְשָׁם וַיַּגִּיעוּ עַד־שַׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
text: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near unto the gates of death—

original: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
text: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses;

original: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵם וִימַלֵּט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָם׃
text: He sent His word, and healed them, And delivered them from their graves.

original: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
text: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

original: וְיִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי תוֹדָה וִיסַפְּרוּ מַעֲשָׂיו בְּרִנָּה׃
text: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with singing.

original: יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה בְּמַיִם רַבִּים׃
text: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters—

original: הֵמָּה רָאוּ מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו בִּמְצוּלָה׃
text: These saw the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep;

original: וַיֹּאמֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד רוּחַ סְעָרָה וַתְּרוֹמֵם גַּלָּיו׃
text: For He commanded, and raised the stormy wind, Which lifted up the waves thereof;

original: יַעֲלוּ שָׁמַיִם יֵרְדוּ תְהוֹמוֹת נַפְשָׁם בְּרָעָה תִתְמוֹגָג׃
text: They mounted up to the heaven, they went down to the deeps; Their soul melted away because of trouble;

original: יָחוֹגּוּ וְיָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּוֹר וְכָל־חָכְמָתָם תִּתְבַּלָּע׃
text: They reeled to and fro, and staggered like a drunken man, And all their wisdom was swallowed up—

original: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם וּמִמְּצוּקֹתֵיהֶם יוֹצִיאֵם׃
text: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.

original: יָקֵם סְעָרָה לִדְמָמָה וַיֶּחֱשׁוּ גַּלֵּיהֶם׃
text: He made the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof were still.

original: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כִי־יִשְׁתֹּקוּ וַיַּנְחֵם אֶל־מְחוֹז חֶפְצָם׃
text: Then were they glad because they were quiet, And He led them unto their desired haven.

original: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
text: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

original: וִירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָם וּבְמוֹשַׁב זְקֵנִים יְהַלְלוּהוּ׃
text: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the seat of the elders.

original: יָשֵׂם נְהָרוֹת לְמִדְבָּר וּמֹצָאֵי מַיִם לְצִמָּאוֹן׃
text: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

original: אֶרֶץ פְּרִי לִמְלֵחָה מֵרָעַת יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
text: A fruitful land into a salt waste, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

original: יָשֵׂם מִדְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמֹצָאֵי מָיִם׃
text: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

original: וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם רְעֵבִים וַיְכוֹנְנוּ עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
text: And there He maketh the hungry to dwell, And they establish a city of habitation;

original: וַיִּזְרְעוּ שָׂדוֹת וַיִּטְּעוּ כְרָמִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פְּרִי תְבוּאָה׃
text: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, Which yield fruits of increase.

original: וַיְבָרֲכֵם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד וּבְהֶמְתָּם לֹא יַמְעִיט׃
text: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly, And suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

original: וַיִּמְעֲטוּ וַיָּשֹׁחוּ מֵעֹצֶר רָעָה וְיָגוֹן׃
text: Again, they are minished and dwindle away Through oppression of evil and sorrow.

original: שֹׁפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃
text: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

original: וַיְשַׂגֵּב אֶבְיוֹן מֵעוֹנִי וַיָּשֶׂם כַּצֹּאן מִשְׁפָּחוֹת׃
text: Yet setteth He the needy on high from affliction, And maketh his families like a flock.

original: יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל־עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃
text: The upright see it, and are glad; And all iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

original: מִי־חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּוֹנְנוּ חַסְדֵי יְהוָה׃
text: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, And let them consider the mercies of the LORD.

original: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
text: A Song, a Psalm of David.

original: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה אַף־כְּבוֹדִי׃
text: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

original: עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃
text: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.

original: אוֹדְךָ בָעַמִּים יְהוָה וַאֲזַמֶּרְךָ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃
text: I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.

original: כִּי־גָדוֹל מֵעַל־שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְעַד־שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
text: For Thy mercy is great above the heavens, And Thy truth reacheth unto the skies.

original: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים וְעַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
text: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; And Thy glory be above all the earth.

original: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי׃
text: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.

original: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
text: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

original: לִי גִלְעָד לִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
text: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

original: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עֲלֵי־פְלֶשֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָע׃
text: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Over Philistia do I cry aloud.

original: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מִבְצָר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?

original: הֲלֹא־אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאֹתֵינוּ׃
text: Hast not Thou cast us off, O God? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts?

original: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
text: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

original: בֵּאלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה־חָיִל וְהוּא יָבוּס צָרֵינוּ׃
text: Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.

original: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ׃
text: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, keep not silence;

original: כִּי פִי רָשָׁע וּפִי־מִרְמָה עָלַי פָּתָחוּ דִּבְּרוּ אִתִּי לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃
text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me; They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

original: וְדִבְרֵי שִׂנְאָה סְבָבוּנִי וַיִּלָּחֲמוּנִי חִנָּם׃
text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

original: תַּחַת־אַהֲבָתִי יִשְׂטְנוּנִי וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּה׃
text: In return for my love they are my adversaries; But I am all prayer.

original: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלַי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה וְשִׂנְאָה תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִי׃
text: And they have laid upon me evil for good, And hatred for my love:

original: הַפְקֵד עָלָיו רָשָׁע וְשָׂטָן יַעֲמֹד עַל־יְמִינוֹ׃
text: ’Set Thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

original: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ יֵצֵא רָשָׁע וּתְפִלָּתוֹ תִּהְיֶה לַחֲטָאָה׃
text: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

original: יִהְיוּ־יָמָיו מְעַטִּים פְּקֻדָּתוֹ יִקַּח אַחֵר׃
text: Let his days be few; Let another take his charge.

original: יִהְיוּ־בָנָיו יְתוֹמִים וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָה׃
text: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

original: וְנוֹעַ יָנוּעוּ בָנָיו וְשִׁאֵלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶם׃
text: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.

original: יְנַקֵּשׁ נוֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְיָבֹזּוּ זָרִים יְגִיעוֹ׃
text: Let the creditor distrain all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labour.

original: אַל־יְהִי־לוֹ מֹשֵׁךְ חָסֶד וְאַל־יְהִי חוֹנֵן לִיתוֹמָיו׃
text: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to be gracious unto his fatherless children.

original: יְהִי־אַחֲרִיתוֹ לְהַכְרִית בְּדוֹר אַחֵר יִמַּח שְׁמָם׃
text: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

original: יִזָּכֵר עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָה וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ אַל־תִּמָּח׃
text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be brought to remembrance unto the LORD; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

original: יִהְיוּ נֶגֶד־יְהוָה תָּמִיד וְיַכְרֵת מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
text: Let them be before the LORD continually, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

original: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא זָכַר עֲשׂוֹת חָסֶד וַיִּרְדֹּף אִישׁ־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵה לֵבָב לְמוֹתֵת׃
text: Because that he remembered not to do kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart he was ready to slay.

original: וַיֶּאֱהַב קְלָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵהוּ וְלֹא־חָפֵץ בִּבְרָכָה וַתִּרְחַק מִמֶּנּוּ׃
text: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it is far from him.

original: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְּמַדּוֹ וַתָּבֹא כַמַּיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְכַשֶּׁמֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו׃
text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his raiment, And it is come into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

original: תְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבֶגֶד יַעְטֶה וּלְמֵזַח תָּמִיד יַחְגְּרֶהָ׃
text: Let it be unto him as the garment which he putteth on, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.'

original: זֹאת פְּעֻלַּת שֹׂטְנַי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְהַדֹּבְרִים רָע עַל־נַפְשִׁי׃
text: This would mine adversaries effect from the LORD, And they that speak evil against my soul.

original: וְאַתָּה יְהוִה אֲדֹנָי עֲ‍שֵׂה־אִתִּי לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃
text: But Thou, O GOD the Lord, deal with me for Thy name's sake; Because Thy mercy is good, deliver Thou me.

original: כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנֹכִי וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי׃
text: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

original: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹתוֹ נֶהֱלָכְתִּי נִנְעַרְתִּי כָּאַרְבֶּה׃
text: I am gone like the shadow when it lengtheneth; I am shaken off as the locust.

original: בִּרְכַּי כָּשְׁלוּ מִצּוֹם וּבְשָׂרִי כָּחַשׁ מִשָּׁמֶן׃
text: My knees totter through fasting; And my flesh is lean, and hath no fatness.

original: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה לָהֶם יִרְאוּנִי יְנִיעוּן רֹאשָׁם׃
text: I am become also a taunt unto them; When they see me, they shake their head.

original: עָזְרֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כְחַסְדֶּךָ׃
text: Help me, O LORD my God; O save me according to Thy mercy;

original: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָדְךָ זֹּאת אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲשִׂיתָהּ׃
text: That they may know that this is Thy hand; That Thou, LORD, hast done it.

original: יְקַלְלוּ־הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָח׃
text: Let them curse, but bless Thou; When they arise, they shall be put to shame, but Thy servant shall rejoice.

original: יִלְבְּשׁוּ שׂוֹטְנַי כְּלִמָּה וְיַעֲטוּ כַמְעִיל בָּשְׁתָּם׃
text: Mine adversaries shall be clothed with confusion, And shall put on their own shame as a robe.

original: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּפִי וּבְתוֹךְ רַבִּים אֲהַלְלֶנּוּ׃
text: I will give great thanks unto the LORD with my mouth; Yea, I will praise Him among the multitude;

original: כִּי־יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשׁוֹ׃
text: Because He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.

original: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר נְאֻם יְהוָה לַאדֹנִי שֵׁב לִימִינִי עַד־אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ׃
text: A Psalm of David. The LORD saith unto my lord: ‘Sit thou at My right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.'

original: מַטֵּה־עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן רְדֵה בְּקֶרֶב אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
text: The rod of Thy strength the LORD will send out of Zion: 'Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.'

original: עַמְּךָ נְדָבֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ בְּהַדְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר לְךָ טַל יַלְדֻתֶיךָ׃
text: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy warfare; in adornments of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, Thine is the dew of thy youth.

original: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם אַתָּה־כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל־דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק׃
text: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent: 'Thou art a priest for ever After the manner of Melchizedek.'

original: אֲדֹנָי עַל־יְמִינְךָ מָחַץ בְּיוֹם־אַפּוֹ מְלָכִים׃
text: The Lord at thy right hand Doth crush kings in the day of His wrath.

original: יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל־אֶרֶץ רַבָּה׃
text: He will judge among the nations; He filleth it with the dead bodies, He crusheth the head over a wide land.

original: מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה עַל־כֵּן יָרִים רֹאשׁ׃
text: He will drink of the brook in the way; Therefore will he lift up the head.

original: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָה׃
text: Hallelujah. I will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart, . In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

original: גְּדֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה דְּרוּשִׁים לְכָל־חֶפְצֵיהֶם׃
text: The works of the LORD are great, Sought out of all them that have delight therein.

original: הוֹד־וְהָדָר פָּעֳלוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
text: His work is glory and majesty; And His righteousness endureth for ever.

original: זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה׃
text: He hath made a memorial for His wonderful works; The LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

original: טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ׃
text: He hath given food unto them that fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.

original: כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִם׃
text: He hath declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.

original: מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָיו׃
text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; All His precepts are sure.

original: סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִם בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָׁר׃
text: They are established for ever and ever, They are done in truth and uprightness.

original: פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּה־לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ׃
text: He hath sent redemption unto His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever; Holy and awful is His name.

original: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.

original: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אַשְׁרֵי־אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה בְּמִצְוֺתָיו חָפֵץ מְאֹד׃
text: Hallelujah. Happy is the man that feareth the LORD, That delighteth greatly in His commandments.

original: גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה זַרְעוֹ דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים יְבֹרָךְ׃
text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

original: הוֹן־וָעֹשֶׁר בְּבֵיתוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
text: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his merit endureth for ever.

original: זָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר לַיְשָׁרִים חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם וְצַדִּיק׃
text: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, Gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

original: טוֹב־אִישׁ חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה יְכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּט׃
text: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, That ordereth his affairs rightfully.

original: כִּי־לְעוֹלָם לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְזֵכֶר עוֹלָם יִהְיֶה צַדִּיק׃
text: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

original: מִשְּׁמוּעָה רָעָה לֹא יִירָא נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטֻחַ בַּיהוָה׃
text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is stedfast, trusting in the LORD.

original: סָמוּךְ לִבּוֹ לֹא יִירָא עַד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶה בְצָרָיו׃
text: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he gaze upon his adversaries.

original: פִּזַּר נָתַן לָאֶבְיוֹנִים צִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד קַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בְּכָבוֹד׃
text: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever; His horn shall be exalted in honour.

original: רָשָׁע יִרְאֶה וְכָעָס שִׁנָּיו יַחֲרֹק וְנָמָס תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
text: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.

original: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה׃
text: Hallelujah. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, Praise the name of the LORD.

original: יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
text: Blessed be the name of the LORD From this time forth and for ever.

original: מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְהוָה׃
text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof The LORD'S name is to be praised.

original: רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְהוָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
text: The LORD is high above all nations, His glory is above the heavens.

original: מִי כַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַמַּגְבִּיהִי לָשָׁבֶת׃
text: Who is like unto the LORD our God, That is enthroned on high,

original: הַמַּשְׁפִּילִי לִרְאוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ׃
text: That looketh down low Upon heaven and upon the earth?

original: מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן׃
text: Who raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy out of the dunghill;

original: לְהוֹשִׁיבִי עִם־נְדִיבִים עִם נְדִיבֵי עַמּוֹ׃
text: That He may set him with princes, Even with the princes of His people.

original: מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: Who maketh the barren woman to dwell in her house As a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.

original: בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם בֵּית יַעֲקֹב מֵעַם לֹעֵז׃
text: When Israel came forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

original: הָיְתָה יְהוּדָה לְקָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָיו׃
text: Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

original: הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃
text: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan turned backward.

original: הֶהָרִים רָקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן׃
text: The mountains skipped like rams, The hills like young sheep.

original: מַה־לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס הַיַּרְדֵּן תִּסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃
text: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest backward?

original: הֶהָרִים תִּרְקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן׃
text: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye hills, like young sheep?

original: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב׃
text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob;

original: הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם־מָיִם חַלָּמִישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָיִם׃
text: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.

original: לֹא לָנוּ יְהוָה לֹא לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
text: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, But unto Thy name give glory, For Thy mercy, and for Thy truth's sake.

original: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה־נָא אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃
text: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is now their God?'

original: וֵאלֹהֵינוּ בַשָּׁמָיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ עָשָׂה׃
text: But our God is in the heavens; Whatsoever pleased Him He hath done.

original: עֲ‍צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃
text: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

original: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃
text: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

original: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן׃
text: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

original: יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם׃
text: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they with their throat. .

original: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃
text: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

original: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
text: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!

original: בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
text: O house of Aaron, trust ye in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!

original: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
text: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

original: יְהוָה זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן׃
text: The LORD hath been mindful of us, He will bless— He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

original: יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַקְּטַנִּים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִים׃
text: He will bless them that fear the LORD, Both small and great.

original: יֹסֵף יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶם׃
text: The LORD increase you more and more, You and your children.

original: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
text: Blessed be ye of the LORD Who made heaven and earth.

original: הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַיהוָה וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם׃
text: The heavens are the heavens of the LORD; But the earth hath He given to the children of men.

original: לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה׃
text: The dead praise not the LORD, Neither any that go down into silence;

original: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: But we will bless the LORD From this time forth and for ever. Hallelujah.

original: אָהַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֶת־קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
text: I love that the LORD should hear my voice and my supplications.

original: כִּי־הִטָּה אָזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָא׃
text: Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon Him all my days.

original: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא׃
text: The cords of death compassed me, And the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.

original: וּבְשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְהוָה מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי׃
text: But I called upon the name of the LORD: 'I beseech thee, O LORD, deliver my soul.'

original: חַנּוּן יְהֹוָה וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵינוּ מְרַחֵם׃
text: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yea, our God is compassionate.

original: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְהֹוָה דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ׃
text: The LORD preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.

original: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּי־יְהוָה גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי׃
text: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; For the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

original: כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּחִי׃
text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from stumbling.

original: אֶתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּאַרְצוֹת הַחַיִּים׃
text: I shall walk before the LORD In the lands of the living.

original: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד׃
text: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'

original: אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי כָּל־הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב׃
text: I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'

original: מָה־אָשִׁיב לַיהוָה כָּל־תַּגְמוּלוֹהִי עָלָי׃
text: How can I repay unto the LORD All His bountiful dealings toward me?

original: כּוֹס־יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃
text: I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.

original: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ׃
text: My vows will I pay unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people.

original: יָקָר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה הַמָּוְתָה לַחֲסִידָיו׃
text: Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His saints.

original: אָנָּה יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲ‍נִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי׃
text: I beseech Thee, O LORD, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.

original: לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃
text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.

original: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ׃
text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people;

original: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה בְּתוֹכֵכִי יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: In the courts of the LORD’S house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

original: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כָּל־הָאֻמִּים׃
text: O praise the LORD, all ye nations; Laud Him, all ye peoples.

original: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
text: For His mercy is great toward us; And the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Hallelujah.

original: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.

original: יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: So let Israel now say, For His mercy endureth for ever,

original: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא בֵית־אַהֲרֹן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: So let the house of Aaron now say, For His mercy endureth for ever.

original: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא יִרְאֵי יְהוָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: So let them now that fear the LORD say, For His mercy endureth for ever.

original: מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ עָנָנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ׃
text: Out of my straits I called upon the LORD; He answered me with great enlargement.

original: יְהוָה לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם׃
text: The LORD is for me; I will not fear; What can man do unto me?

original: יְהוָה לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשֹׂנְאָי׃
text: The LORD is for me as my helper; And I shall gaze upon them that hate me.

original: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בָּאָדָם׃
text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in man.

original: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בִּנְדִיבִים׃
text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in princes.

original: כָּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
text: All nations compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

original: סַבּוּנִי גַם־סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
text: They compass me about, yea, they compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

original: סַבּוּנִי כִדְבוֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
text: They compass me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

original: דַּחֹה דְחִיתַנִי לִנְפֹּל וַיהוָה עֲזָרָנִי׃
text: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But the LORD helped me.

original: עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃
text: The LORD is my strength and song; And He is become my salvation.

original: קוֹל רִנָּה וִישׁוּעָה בְּאָהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃
text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

original: יְמִין יְהוָה רוֹמֵמָה יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃
text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

original: לֹא אָמוּת כִּי־אֶחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַעֲשֵׂי יָהּ׃
text: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the LORD.

original: יַסֹּר יִסְּרַנִּי יָּהּ וְלַמָּוֶת לֹא נְתָנָנִי׃
text: The LORD hath chastened me sore; But He hath not given me over unto death.

original: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶדֶק אָבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ׃
text: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto the LORD.

original: זֶה־הַשַּׁעַר לַיהוָה צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ׃
text: This is the gate of the LORD; The righteous shall enter into it.

original: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃
text: I will give thanks unto Thee, for Thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

original: אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה׃
text: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the chief corner-stone.

original: מֵאֵת יְהוָה הָיְתָה זֹּאת הִיא נִפְלָאת בְּעֵינֵינוּ׃
text: This is the LORD’S doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.

original: זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ׃
text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

original: אָנָּא יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא אָנָּא יְהוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָּא׃
text: We beseech Thee, O LORD, save now! We beseech Thee, O LORD, make us now to prosper!

original: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְהוָה׃
text: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD; We bless you out of the house of the LORD.

original: אֵל יְהוָה וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ אִסְרוּ־חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
text: The LORD is God, and hath given us light; Order the festival procession with boughs, even unto the horns of the altar.

original: אֵלִי אַתָּה וְאוֹדֶךָּ אֱלֹהַי אֲרוֹמְמֶךָּ׃
text: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto Thee; Thou art my God, I will exalt Thee.

original: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.

original: אַשְׁרֵי תְמִימֵי־דָרֶךְ הַהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה׃
text: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

original: אַשְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵי עֵדֹתָיו בְּכָל־לֵב יִדְרְשׁוּהוּ׃
text: Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.

original: אַף לֹא־פָעֲלוּ עַוְלָה בִּדְרָכָיו הָלָכוּ׃
text: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.

original: אַתָּה צִוִּיתָה פִקֻּדֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מְאֹד׃
text: Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.

original: אַחֲלַי יִכֹּנוּ דְרָכָי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!

original: אָז לֹא־אֵבוֹשׁ בְּהַבִּיטִי אֶל־כָּל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
text: Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.

original: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
text: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances. .

original: אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ אֶשְׁמֹר אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־מְאֹד׃
text: I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.

original: בַּמֶּה יְזַכֶּה־נַּעַר אֶת־אָרְחוֹ לִשְׁמֹר כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
text: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.

original: בְּכָל־לִבִּי דְרַשְׁתִּיךָ אַל־תַּשְׁגֵּנִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
text: With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.

original: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ׃
text: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.

original: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: Blessed art Thou, O LORD; Teach me Thy statutes.

original: בִּשְׂפָתַי סִפַּרְתִּי כֹּל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיךָ׃
text: With my lips have I told All the ordinances of Thy mouth.

original: בְּדֶרֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שַׂשְׂתִּי כְּעַל כָּל־הוֹן׃
text: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.

original: בְּפִקֻּדֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה וְאַבִּיטָה אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ׃
text: I will meditate in Thy precepts, And have respect unto Thy ways.

original: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ אֶשְׁתַּעֲשָׁע לֹא אֶשְׁכַּח דְּבָרֶךָ׃
text: I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.

original: גְּמֹל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְיֶה וְאֶשְׁמְרָה דְבָרֶךָ׃
text: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.

original: גַּל־עֵינַי וְאַבִּיטָה נִפְלָאוֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
text: Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.

original: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
text: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.

original: גָּרְסָה נַפְשִׁי לְתַאֲבָה אֶל־מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ בְכָל־עֵת׃
text: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.

original: גָּעַרְתָּ זֵדִים אֲרוּרִים הַשֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
text: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.

original: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
text: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.

original: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: Even though princes sit and talk against me, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.

original: גַּם־עֵדֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אַנְשֵׁי עֲצָתִי׃
text: Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors. DALETH.

original: דָּבְקָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשִׁי חַיֵּנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
text: My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.

original: דְּרָכַי סִפַּרְתִּי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.

original: דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶיךָ הֲבִינֵנִי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
text: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.

original: דָּלְפָה נַפְשִׁי מִתּוּגָה קַיְּמֵנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
text: My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.

original: דֶּרֶךְ־שֶׁקֶר הָסֵר מִמֶּנִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ חָנֵּנִי׃
text: Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.

original: דֶּרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָה בָחָרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ שִׁוִּיתִי׃
text: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set [before me].

original: דָּבַקְתִּי בְעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ יְהוָה אַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי׃
text: I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O LORD, put me not to shame.

original: דֶּרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּי׃
text: I will run the way of Thy commandments, For Thou dost enlarge my heart.

original: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב׃
text: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Thy statutes; And I will keep it at every step.

original: הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָה תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶנָּה בְכָל־לֵב׃
text: Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.

original: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִיב מִצְוֺתֶיךָ כִּי־בוֹ חָפָצְתִּי׃
text: Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

original: הַט־לִבִּי אֶל־עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ וְאַל אֶל־בָּצַע׃
text: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

original: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
text: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.

original: הָקֵם לְעַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לְיִרְאָתֶךָ׃
text: Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.

original: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים׃
text: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.

original: הִנֵּה תָּאַבְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶיךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
text: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.

original: וִיבֹאֻנִי חֲסָדֶךָ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָתְךָ כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃
text: VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O LORD, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;

original: וְאֶעֱנֶה חֹרְפִי דָבָר כִּי־בָטַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
text: That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.

original: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;

original: וְאֶשְׁמְרָה תוֹרָתְךָ תָמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
text: So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;

original: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָה בָרְחָבָה כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי׃
text: And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;

original: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
text: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.

original: וְאֶשְׁתַּעֲשַׁע בְּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי׃
text: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.

original: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate in Thy statutes.

original: זְכֹר־דָּבָר לְעַבְדֶּךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר יִחַלְתָּנִי׃
text: ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, Because Thou hast made me to hope.

original: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי׃
text: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.

original: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
text: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.

original: זָכַרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם יְהוָה וָאֶתְנֶחָם׃
text: I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself. .

original: זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים עֹזְבֵי תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
text: Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.

original: זְמִרוֹת הָיוּ־לִי חֻקֶּיךָ בְּבֵית מְגוּרָי׃
text: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

original: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
text: I have remembered Thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have observed Thy law.

original: זֹאת הָיְתָה־לִּי כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
text: This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.

original: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶיךָ׃
text: HETH. My portion is the LORD, I have said that I would observe Thy words.

original: חִלִּיתִי פָנֶיךָ בְכָל־לֵב חָנֵּנִי כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃
text: I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.

original: חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְרָכָי וָאָשִׁיבָה רַגְלַי אֶל־עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
text: I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.

original: חַשְׁתִּי וְלֹא הִתְמַהְמָהְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
text: I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.

original: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
text: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.

original: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.

original: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
text: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.

original: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
text: The earth, O LORD, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.

original: טוֹב עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
text: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O LORD, according unto Thy word.

original: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי׃
text: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in Thy commandments.

original: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי׃
text: Before I was afflicted, I did err; But now I observe Thy word.

original: טוֹב־אַתָּה וּמֵטִיב לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me Thy statutes.

original: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
text: The proud have forged a lie against me; But I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.

original: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי׃
text: Their heart is gross like fat; But I delight in Thy law.

original: טוֹב־לִי כִי־עֻנֵּיתִי לְמַעַן אֶלְמַד חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I might learn Thy statutes.

original: טוֹב־לִי תוֹרַת־פִּיךָ מֵאַלְפֵי זָהָב וָכָסֶף׃
text: The law of Thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.

original: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
text: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.

original: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
text: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.

original: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי׃
text: I know, O LORD, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me. .

original: יְהִי־נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵנִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃
text: Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, According to Thy promise unto Thy servant.

original: יְבֹאוּנִי רַחֲמֶיךָ וְאֶחְיֶה כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃
text: Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.

original: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ׃
text: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.

original: יָשׁוּבוּ לִי יְרֵאֶיךָ וידעו [וְיֹדְעֵי] עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
text: Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.

original: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
text: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.

original: כָּלְתָה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ נַפְשִׁי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
text: CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.

original: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
text: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, Saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'

original: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
text: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.

original: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט׃
text: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

original: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ׃
text: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.

original: כָּל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמוּנָה שֶׁקֶר רְדָפוּנִי עָזְרֵנִי׃
text: All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.

original: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ׃
text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.

original: כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדוּת פִּיךָ׃
text: Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.

original: לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה דְּבָרְךָ נִצָּב בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃
text: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.

original: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד׃
text: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.

original: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
text: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.

original: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי׃
text: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

original: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי׃
text: I will never forget Thy precepts; for with them Thou hast quickened me.

original: לְךָ־אֲנִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי׃
text: I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.

original: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן׃
text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; but I will consider Thy testimonies.

original: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד׃
text: I have seen an end to every purpose; but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.

original: מָה־אָהַבְתִּי תוֹרָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִיא שִׂיחָתִי׃
text: MEM. O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

original: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי׃
text: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies: For they are ever with me.

original: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי׃
text: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For Thy testimonies are my meditation.

original: מִזְּקֵנִים אֶתְבּוֹנָן כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
text: I understand more than mine elders, because I have keep Thy precepts.

original: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ׃
text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, in order that I might observe Thy word.

original: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לֹא־סָרְתִּי כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹרֵתָנִי׃
text: I have not turned aside from Thine ordinances; For Thou hast instructed me.

original: מַה־נִּמְלְצוּ לְחִכִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ מִדְּבַשׁ לְפִי׃
text: How sweet are Thy words unto my palate! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

original: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר׃
text: From Thy precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.

original: נֵר־לְרַגְלִי דְבָרֶךָ וְאוֹר לִנְתִיבָתִי׃
text: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.

original: נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּמָה לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
text: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, To observe Thy righteous ordinances.

original: נַעֲנֵיתִי עַד־מְאֹד יְהוָה חַיֵּנִי כִדְבָרֶךָ׃
text: I am afflicted very much; Quicken me, O LORD, according unto Thy word.

original: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
text: Accept, I beseech Thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Thine ordinances.

original: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
text: My soul is continually in my hand; yet have I not forgotten Thy law.

original: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי׃
text: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet went I not astray from Thy precepts.

original: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה׃
text: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

original: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב׃
text: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes, for ever, at every step.

original: סֵעֲפִים שָׂנֵאתִי וְתוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי׃
text: SAMECH. I hate them that are of a double mind; but Thy law do I love.

original: סִתְרִי וּמָגִנִּי אָתָּה לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
text: Thou art my covert and my shield; in Thy word do I hope.

original: סוּרוּ־מִמֶּנִּי מְרֵעִים וְאֶצְּרָה מִצְוֺת אֱלֹהָי׃
text: Depart from me, ye evildoers; that I may keep the commandments of my God.

original: סָמְכֵנִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ וְאֶחְיֶה וְאַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי מִשִּׂבְרִי׃
text: Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live; and put me not to shame in my hope.

original: סְעָדֵנִי וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה וְאֶשְׁעָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ תָמִיד׃
text: Support Thou me, and I shall be saved; and I will occupy myself with Thy statutes continually.

original: סָלִיתָ כָּל־שׁוֹגִים מֵחֻקֶּיךָ כִּי־שֶׁקֶר תַּרְמִיתָם׃
text: Thou hast made light of all them that err from Thy statutes; for their deceit is vain.

original: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Thy testimonies.

original: סָמַר מִפַּחְדְּךָ בְשָׂרִי וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יָרֵאתִי׃
text: My flesh shuddereth for fear of Thee; And I am afraid of Thy judgments.

original: עָשִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּט וָצֶדֶק בַּל־תַּנִּיחֵנִי לְעֹשְׁקָי׃
text: AIN. I have done justice and righteousness; Leave me not to mine oppressors.

original: עֲרֹב עַבְדְּךָ לְטוֹב אַל־יַעַשְׁקֻנִי זֵדִים׃
text: Be surety for Thy servant for good; Let not the proud oppress me.

original: עֵינַי כָּלוּ לִישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּלְאִמְרַת צִדְקֶךָ׃
text: Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for Thy righteous word.

original: עֲשֵׂה עִם־עַבְדְּךָ כְחַסְדֶּךָ וְחֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
text: Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes.

original: עַבְדְּךָ־אָנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֵדְעָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
text: I am Thy servant, give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.

original: עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַיהוָה הֵפֵרוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
text: It is time for the LORD to work; They have made void Thy law.

original: עַל־כֵּן אָהַבְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ מִזָּהָב וּמִפָּז׃
text: Therefore I love Thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

original: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי׃
text: Therefore I esteem all [Thy] precepts concerning all things to be right; Every false way I hate.

original: פְּלָאוֹת עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן נְצָרָתַם נַפְשִׁי׃
text: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.

original: פֵּתַח דְּבָרֶיךָ יָאִיר מֵבִין פְּתָיִים׃
text: The opening of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

original: פִּי־פָעַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָפָה כִּי לְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ יָאָבְתִּי׃
text: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for Thy commandments.

original: פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כְּמִשְׁפָּט לְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
text: Turn Thee towards me, and be gracious unto me, As is Thy wont to do unto those that love Thy name.

original: פְּעָמַי הָכֵן בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ וְאַל־תַּשְׁלֶט־בִּי כָל־אָוֶן׃
text: Order my footsteps by Thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

original: פְּדֵנִי מֵעֹשֶׁק אָדָם וְאֶשְׁמְרָה פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, And I will observe Thy precepts.

original: פָּנֶיךָ הָאֵר בְּעַבְדֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; And teach me Thy statutes.

original: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ׃
text: Mine eyes run down with rivers of water, Because they observe not Thy law.

original: צַדִּיק אַתָּה יְהוָה וְיָשָׁר מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃
text: TZADE. Righteous art Thou, O LORD, And upright are Thy judgments.

original: צִוִּיתָ צֶדֶק עֵדֹתֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה מְאֹד׃
text: Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.

original: צִמְּתַתְנִי קִנְאָתִי כִּי־שָׁכְחוּ דְבָרֶיךָ צָרָי׃
text: My zeal hath undone me, because mine adversaries have forgotten Thy words.

original: צְרוּפָה אִמְרָתְךָ מְאֹד וְעַבְדְּךָ אֲהֵבָהּ׃
text: Thy word is tried to the uttermost, and Thy servant loveth it.

original: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
text: I am small and despised; yet have I not forgotten Thy precepts.

original: צִדְקָתְךָ צֶדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת׃
text: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is truth.

original: צַר־וּמָצוֹק מְצָאוּנִי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃
text: Trouble and anguish have overtaken me; yet Thy commandments are my delight.

original: צֶדֶק עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶחְיֶה׃
text: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever; give me understanding, and I shall live.

original: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה׃
text: KOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD; I will keep Thy statutes.

original: קְרָאתִיךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
text: I have called Thee, save me, and I will observe Thy testimonies.

original: קִדַּמְתִּי בַנֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּעָה לדבריך [לִדְבָרְךָ] יִחָלְתִּי׃
text: I rose early at dawn, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.

original: קִדְּמוּ עֵינַי אַשְׁמֻרוֹת לָשִׂיחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃
text: Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, that I might meditate in Thy word.

original: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
text: Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; Quicken me, O LORD, as Thou art wont.

original: קָרְבוּ רֹדְפֵי זִמָּה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ רָחָקוּ׃
text: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; they are far from Thy law.

original: קָרוֹב אַתָּה יְהוָה וְכָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמֶת׃
text: Thou art nigh, O LORD; and all Thy commandments are truth.

original: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם׃
text: Of old have I known from Thy testimonies that Thou hast founded them for ever.

original: רְאֵה־עָנְיִי וְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
text: RESH. O see mine affliction, and rescue me; For I do not forget Thy law.

original: רִיבָה רִיבִי וּגְאָלֵנִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
text: Plead Thou my cause, and redeem me; Quicken me according to Thy word.

original: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ׃
text: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not Thy statutes.

original: רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
text: Great are Thy compassions, O LORD; Quicken me as Thou art wont.

original: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
text: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not turned aside from Thy testimonies.

original: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
text: I beheld them that were faithless, and strove with them; Because they observed not Thy word.

original: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
text: O see how I love Thy precepts; Quicken me, O LORD, according to Thy lovingkindness.

original: רֹאשׁ־דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וּלְעוֹלָם כָּל־מִשְׁפַּט צִדְקֶךָ׃
text: The beginning of Thy word is truth; And all Thy righteous ordinance endureth for ever.

original: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך [וּמִדְּבָרְךָ] פָּחַד לִבִּי׃
text: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of Thy words.

original: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃
text: I rejoice at Thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.

original: שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵבָה תּוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי׃
text: I hate and abhor falsehood; Thy law do I love. .

original: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
text: Seven times a day do I praise Thee, because of Thy righteous ordinances.

original: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל׃
text: Great peace have they that love Thy law; And there is no stumbling for them.

original: שִׂבַּרְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי׃
text: I have hoped for Thy salvation, O LORD, And have done Thy commandments.

original: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶיךָ וָאֹהֲבֵם מְאֹד׃
text: My soul hath observed Thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

original: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
text: I have observed Thy precepts and Thy testimonies; For all my ways are before Thee.

original: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי׃
text: TAV. Let my cry come near before Thee, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Thy word.

original: תָּבוֹא תְּחִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ כְּאִמְרָתְךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃
text: Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word.

original: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
text: Let my lips utter praise: Because Thou teachest me Thy statutes.

original: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק׃
text: Let my tongue sing of Thy word; For all Thy commandments are righteousness.

original: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ לְעָזְרֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ בָחָרְתִּי׃
text: Let Thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen Thy precepts.

original: תָּאַבְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וְתוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃
text: I have longed for Thy salvation, O LORD; And Thy law is my delight.

original: תְּחִי־נַפְשִׁי וּתְהַלְלֶךָּ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יַעֲזְרֻנִי׃
text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; And let Thine ordinances help me.

original: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant; For I have not forgotten Thy commandments.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי׃
text: A Song of Ascents. In my distress I called unto the LORD, And He answered me.

original: יְהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
text: O LORD, deliver my soul from lying lips, From a deceitful tongue.

original: מַה־יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
text: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?

original: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִים׃
text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of broom.

original: אוֹיָה־לִי כִּי־גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִם־אָהֳלֵי קֵדָר׃
text: Woe is me, that I sojourn with Meshech, That I dwell beside the tents of Kedar!

original: רַבַּת שָׁכְנָה־לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלוֹם׃
text: My soul hath full long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.

original: אֲ‍נִי־שָׁלוֹם וְכִי אֲדַבֵּר הֵמָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃
text: I am all peace; But when I speak, they are for war.

original: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי׃
text: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

original: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
text: My help cometh from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.

original: אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ אַל־יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶךָ׃
text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

original: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
text: Behold, He that keepeth Israel Doth neither slumber nor sleep.

original: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ׃
text: The LORD is thy keeper; The LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

original: יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹא־יַכֶּכָּה וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּיְלָה׃
text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.

original: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָרְךָ מִכָּל־רָע יִשְׁמֹר אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃
text: The LORD shall keep thee from all evil; He shall keep thy soul.

original: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
text: The LORD shall guard thy going out and thy coming in, From this time forth and for ever.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵךְ׃
text: A Song of Ascents; of David. I rejoiced when they said unto me: 'Let us go unto the house of the LORD.'

original: עֹמְדוֹת הָיוּ רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
text: Our feet are standing within thy gates, O Jerusalem;

original: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הַבְּנוּיָה כְּעִיר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּהּ יַחְדָּו׃
text: Jerusalem, that art builded as a city that is compact together;

original: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
text: Whither the tribes went up, even the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony unto Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

original: כִּי שָׁמָּה יָשְׁבוּ כִסְאוֹת לְמִשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹת לְבֵית דָּוִיד׃
text: For there were set thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

original: שַׁאֲלוּ שְׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהֲבָיִךְ׃
text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; May they prosper that love thee.

original: יְהִי־שָׁלוֹם בְּחֵילֵךְ שַׁלְוָה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָיִךְ׃
text: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

original: לְמַעַן אַחַי וְרֵעָי אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּךְ׃
text: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say: 'Peace be within thee.'

original: לְמַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁה טוֹב לָךְ׃
text: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־עֵינַי הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃
text: A Song of Ascents. Unto Thee I lift up mine eyes, O Thou that art enthroned in the heavens.

original: הִנֵּה כְעֵינֵי עֲבָדִים אֶל־יַד אֲ‍דוֹנֵיהֶם כְּעֵינֵי שִׁפְחָה אֶל־יַד גְּבִרְתָּהּ כֵּן עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּנוּ׃
text: Behold, as the eyes of servants unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto the LORD our God, Until He be gracious unto us.

original: חָנֵּנוּ יְהוָה חָנֵּנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בוּז׃
text: Be gracious unto us, O LORD, be gracious unto us; For we are full sated with contempt.

original: רַבַּת שָׂבְעָה־לָּהּ נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַלַּעַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים הַבּוּז לִגְאֵיוֹנִים׃
text: Our soul is full sated With the scorning of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud oppressors.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
text: A Song of Ascents; of David. 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us', Let Israel now say;

original: לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ בְּקוּם עָלֵינוּ אָדָם׃
text: 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us, When men rose up against us,

original: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּנוּ׃
text: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

original: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ׃
text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul;

original: אֲזַי עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַמַּיִם הַזֵּידוֹנִים׃
text: Then the proud waters Had gone over our soul.'

original: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶם׃
text: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

original: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ׃
text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

original: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַבֹּטְחִים בַּיהוָה כְּהַר־צִיּוֹן לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב׃
text: A Song of Ascents. They that trust in the LORD Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

original: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הָרִים סָבִיב לָהּ וַיהוָה סָבִיב לְעַמּוֹ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So the LORD is round about His people, From this time forth and for ever.

original: כִּי לֹא יָנוּחַ שֵׁבֶט הָרֶשַׁע עַל גּוֹרַל הַצַּדִּיקִים לְמַעַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְחוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַוְלָתָה יְדֵיהֶם׃
text: For the rod of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.

original: הֵיטִיבָה יְהוָה לַטּוֹבִים וְלִישָׁרִים בְּלִבּוֹתָם׃
text: Do good, O LORD, unto the good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.

original: וְהַמַּטִּים עַקַלְקַלּוֹתָם יוֹלִיכֵם יְהוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵי הָאָוֶן שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
text: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, The LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִים׃
text: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.

original: אָז יִמָּלֵא שְׂחוֹק פִּינוּ וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה אָז יֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִם־אֵלֶּה׃
text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing; then said they among the nations: 'The LORD hath done great things with these.'

original: הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּנוּ הָיִינוּ שְׂמֵחִים׃
text: The LORD hath done great things with us; we are rejoiced.

original: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה אֶת־שבותנו [שְׁבִיתֵנוּ] כַּאֲפִיקִים בַּנֶּגֶב׃
text: Turn our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the dry land.

original: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ׃
text: They that sow in tears Shall reap in joy.

original: הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶשֶׁךְ־הַזָּרַע בֹּא־יָבוֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָיו׃
text: Though he goeth on his way weeping that beareth the measure of seed, He shall come home with joy, bearing his sheaves.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לִשְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִבְנֶה בַיִת שָׁוְא עָמְלוּ בוֹנָיו בּוֹ אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִשְׁמָר־עִיר שָׁוְא שָׁקַד שׁוֹמֵר׃
text: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon. Except the LORD build the house, They labour in vain that build it; Except the LORD keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

original: שָׁוְא לָכֶם מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁבֶת אֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים כֵּן יִתֵּן לִידִידוֹ שֵׁנָא׃
text: It is vain for you that ye rise early, and sit up late, Ye that eat the bread of toil; So He giveth unto His beloved in sleep.

original: הִנֵּה נַחֲלַת יְהוָה בָּנִים שָׂכָר פְּרִי הַבָּטֶן׃
text: Lo, children are a heritage of the LORD; The fruit of the womb is a reward.

original: כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד־גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִים׃
text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of one's youth.

original: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אֶת־אַשְׁפָּתוֹ מֵהֶם לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־יְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִים בַּשָּׁעַר׃
text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them; They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵא יְהוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו׃
text: A Song of Ascents. Happy is every one that feareth the LORD, That walketh in His ways.

original: יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃
text: When thou eatest the labour of thy hands, Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

original: אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ בָּנֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶךָ׃
text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, round about thy table.

original: הִנֵּה כִי־כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא יְהוָה׃
text: Behold, surely thus shall the man be blessed That feareth the LORD.

original: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן וּרְאֵה בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלִָם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃
text: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life;

original: וּרְאֵה־בָנִים לְבָנֶיךָ שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
text: And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרַי יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
text: A Song of Ascents. 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up', Let Israel now say;

original: רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי גַּם לֹא־יָכְלוּ לִי׃
text: 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up; But they have not prevailed against me.

original: עַל־גַּבִּי חָרְשׁוּ חֹרְשִׁים הֶאֱרִיכוּ למענותם [לְמַעֲנִיתָם׃]
text: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.

original: יְהוָה צַדִּיק קִצֵּץ עֲבוֹת רְשָׁעִים׃
text: The LORD is righteous; He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.'

original: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר כֹּל שֹׂנְאֵי צִיּוֹן׃
text: Let them be ashamed and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

original: יִהְיוּ כַּחֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַת שָׁלַף יָבֵשׁ׃
text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth afore it springeth up;

original: שֶׁלֹּא מִלֵּא כַפּוֹ קוֹצֵר וְחִצְנוֹ מְעַמֵּר׃
text: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

original: וְלֹא אָמְרוּ הָעֹבְרִים בִּרְכַּת־יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בֵּרַכְנוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
text: Neither do they that go by say: ‘The blessing of the LORD be upon you; We bless you in the name of the LORD.'

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה׃
text: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I called Thee, O LORD.

original: אֲדֹנָי שִׁמְעָה בְקוֹלִי תִּהְיֶינָה אָזְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבוֹת לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
text: Lord, hearken unto my voice; let Thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

original: אִם־עֲוֺנוֹת תִּשְׁמָר־יָהּ אֲדֹנָי מִי יַעֲמֹד׃
text: If Thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?

original: כִּי־עִמְּךָ הַסְּלִיחָה לְמַעַן תִּוָּרֵא׃
text: For with Thee there is forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.

original: קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה קִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי וְלִדְבָרוֹ הוֹחָלְתִּי׃
text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in His word do I hope.

original: נַפְשִׁי לַאדֹנָי מִשֹּׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר שֹׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר׃
text: My soul waiteth for the Lord, more than watchmen for the morning; yea, more than watchmen for the morning.

original: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי־עִם־יְהוָה הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃
text: O Israel, hope in the LORD; for with the LORD there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.

original: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֺנֹתָיו׃
text: And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד יְהוָה לֹא־גָבַהּ לִבִּי וְלֹא־רָמוּ עֵינַי וְלֹא־הִלַּכְתִּי בִּגְדֹלוֹת וּבְנִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי׃
text: A Song of Ascents; of David. LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in things too great, or in things too wonderful for me.

original: אִם־לֹא שִׁוִּיתִי וְדוֹמַמְתִּי נַפְשִׁי כְּגָמֻל עֲלֵי אִמּוֹ כַּגָּמֻל עָלַי נַפְשִׁי׃
text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother; My soul is with me like a weaned child.

original: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
text: O Israel, hope in the LORD From this time forth and for ever.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ׃
text: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember unto David All his affliction;

original: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
text: How he swore unto the LORD, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

original: אִם־אָבֹא בְּאֹהֶל בֵּיתִי אִם־אֶעֱלֶה עַל־עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָי׃
text: ‘Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, Nor go up into the bed that is spread for me;

original: אִם־אֶתֵּן שְׁנַת לְעֵינָי לְעַפְעַפַּי תְּנוּמָה׃
text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Nor slumber to mine eyelids;

original: עַד־אֶמְצָא מָקוֹם לַיהוָה מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
text: Until I find out a place for the LORD, A dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'

original: הִנֵּה־שְׁמַעֲנוּהָ בְאֶפְרָתָה מְצָאנוּהָ בִּשְׂדֵי־יָעַר׃
text: Lo, we heard of it as being in Ephrath; We found it in the field of athe wood.

original: נָבוֹאָה לְמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו׃
text: Let us go into His dwelling-place; Let us worship at His footstool. .

original: קוּמָה יְהוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ׃
text: Arise, O LORD, unto Thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.

original: כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־צֶדֶק וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
text: Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let Thy saints shout for joy.

original: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
text: For Thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of Thine anointed.

original: נִשְׁבַּע־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֱמֶת לֹא־יָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה מִפְּרִי בִטְנְךָ אָשִׁית לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
text: The LORD swore unto David in truth; He will not turn back from it: 'Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

original: אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ בְּרִיתִי וְעֵדֹתִי זוֹ אֲלַמְּדֵם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם עֲדֵי־עַד יֵשְׁבוּ לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
text: If thy children keep My covenant And My testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also for ever shall sit upon thy throne.'

original: כִּי־בָחַר יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן אִוָּהּ לְמוֹשָׁב לוֹ׃
text: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for His habitation:

original: זֹאת־מְנוּחָתִי עֲדֵי־עַד פֹּה־אֵשֵׁב כִּי אִוִּתִיהָ׃
text: 'This is My resting-place for ever; Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

original: צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ אֶבְיוֹנֶיהָ אַשְׂבִּיעַ לָחֶם׃
text: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will give her needy bread in plenty.

original: וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע וַחֲסִידֶיהָ רַנֵּן יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
text: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

original: שָׁם אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עָרַכְתִּי נֵר לִמְשִׁיחִי׃
text: There will I make a horn to shoot up unto David, There have I ordered a lamp for Mine anointed.

original: אוֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְעָלָיו יָצִיץ נִזְרוֹ׃
text: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown shine.'

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד הִנֵּה מַה־טּוֹב וּמַה־נָּעִים שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם־יָחַד׃
text: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

original: כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל־הָרֹאשׁ יֹרֵד עַל־הַזָּקָן זְקַן־אַהֲרֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו׃
text: It is like the precious oil upon the head, Coming down upon the beard; Even Aaron's beard, That cometh down upon the collar of his garments;

original: כְּטַל־חֶרְמוֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־הַרְרֵי צִיּוֹן כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה חַיִּים עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃
text: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion; For there the LORD commanded the blessing, Even life for ever.

original: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הִנֵּה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת׃
text: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, That stand in the house of the LORD in the night seasons.

original: שְׂאוּ־יְדֵכֶם קֹדֶשׁ וּבָרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye the LORD.
